Als nachtverpleegkundige bij Seniorplaza krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten binnen een multidisciplinair team. Je volgt bewoners op, denkt mee en bouwt een sterke zorgrelatie op. Je bent een baken van rust in de nacht en blinkt uit in het bewaren van de rust. Je zorgt voor de verbinding tussen nacht en dag en brieft je collega's zodat deze aan een vlotte werkshift kunnen beginnen.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit volgens de geldende richtlijnen;
  • je coördineert en bewaakt het zorgplan van bewoners;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen in gezondheidstoestand;
  • je ondersteunt en begeleidt zorgkundigen;
  • je bereid de werking van de volgende dagshift voor;
  • je voert administratieve taken uit in functie van kwalitatieve zorg.

Als nachtverpleegkundige draag je bij aan verpleegkundige handelingen, zorgplanning, opvolging van zorgtrajecten en begeleiding van zorgkundigen. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor persoonsgerichte, kwalitatieve zorg met een sterke band met bewoners en familie. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten klinisch inzicht, communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je coördineert, observeert, beslissingen onderbouwt en als aanspreekpunt fungeert.

Verder vragen wij:

  • professionele bachelor verpleegkunde of HBO5 + visum;
  • ervaring: niet vereist (wel een plus);
  • sterk in zorgplan opvolgen, rapporteren en samenwerken multidisciplinair;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel, stressbestendig en een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

jobs.title: Monteur 30% buitenland
jobs.description:
Wil jij mee werken aan de modernste hightech machines? Vind jij de afwisseling tussen werken in het atelier, bij de klant en ook regelmatig in het buitenland geweldig? Zoek je een job waar je jouw mechanische, elektrische en PLC kennis kan gebruiken? Zijn flexibele werkuren wel gemakkelijk? Dan ben je bij ons aan het juiste adres!

Wij zijn een gezellige KMO die machines maken voor de voedingsindustrie. Onze klanten bevinden in België maar ook evengoed daarbuiten. Zo hebben wij verschillende klanten in Oost-Europa en bijvoorbeeld in Rusland. Wij maken machines voor de productie van chocolade, koekjes, ijsjes, pizza's, hamburgers enz... Denk aan verpakkingsmachines, productiemachines en verschillende robots. Kortom, afwisseling gegarandeerd!

Wat kan je bij ons verwachten?

  • Gemiddeld werk je de helft van de tijd in onze atelier en de andere helft van de tijd bouw je machines op bij onze klanten.
  • Afhankelijk van onze projecten zal je 20 à 40% van jouw tijd machines opbouwen in het buitenland.
  • Je maakt prototypes van installaties en verpakkingsmachines. Dit kan gaan over kleinere machines maar evengoed over lange productielijnen. Sommige projecten duren een paar weken tot bijvoorbeeld 3 maanden. Jouw creatieve oplossingen komen goed van pas om de machines op te bouwen en constructies te verzinnen.
  • De onderdelen van de machines komen gemaakt binnen. Jij zal deze assembleren. Je maakt hierbij gebruik van handmachines zoals een boormachine. Indien nodig zal je af en toe eens een onderdeel aan de machine lassen. Kan je dit niet? Geen probleem! Verder za je ook afkitten.
  • Je doet de elektrische bedrading van de machines. Nadien worden deze getest. Uiteraard krijg je hier in het begin de nodige ondersteuning bij.
  • Je probeert de productieprocessen te optimaliseren. Is er een storing? Dan probeer je deze op te lossen. 
  • De storingen kunnen op mechanisch, elektrisch of op PLC vlak voorkomen. Denk aan draden optimaliseren, sensoren en servomotoren vervangen, camera's vervangen en eventueel een remote op afstand doen.
  • Het programmeren doet één van jouw collega's. Door de programma's te begrijpen, kan je storingen wel sneller helpen oplossen. Door jouw computerkennis, kan je inloggen bij vision systemen om deze te optimaliseren.

Jij komt terecht in een team van 14 collega's. De installaties in het buitenland zal je samen met één collega doen. Jullie projecten kunnen enkele dagen zijn tot maximum 2 weken. Uiteraard krijgen jullie hiervoor de nodige vergoedingen en regelen wij een goede plaats om te overnachten! Doe je deze periode extra uren? Dan kan je deze nadien opnemen als recup. We zorgen ervoor dat je zoveel mogelijk thuis bent in het weekend.

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B zodat je je kan verplaatsen met onze bestelwagens.
  • Werken in het buitenland spreekt jou enorm aan!
  • Jij hebt kennis van machinebouw.

jobs.title: Grondwerker - Wegeniswerker

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Ready to build data platforms, not just pipelines?

 

At Opencast, we believe great data engineering is about more than moving and transforming data. It's about creating reliable, scalable foundations that help organisations make better decisions and deliver better services. 

 

Our consultants tackle complex engineering challenges across integration, migration, modelling and platform design, working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure and modern data technologies. We value engineering craft, thoughtful problem-solving and building solutions that are simple, robust and built to last. 

 

As our data engineering capability continues to grow, you'll have the opportunity to influence its direction through delivery, mentoring, recruitment and technical leadership. If you're looking for a role where you can shape both solutions and the capability around them, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

The role

  

Opencast data engineers help organisations transform how they manage, use and learn from data. The work ranges from building modern lakehouse and warehouse platforms in Microsoft Fabric to modernising legacy environments, migrating complex workloads and improving the quality, governance and reliability of critical data services.  

 

This role offers the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, combining platform design, engineering, integration and optimisation. Expect to work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, building batch and near real-time data pipelines that underpin critical business and public services.  

 

You'll collaborate with architects, analysts, software engineers and client teams to solve complex challenges and influence technical direction. The role also offers opportunities to contribute beyond delivery through mentoring, recruitment, community building and helping to define engineering standards and best practice as our capability continues to grow. 

 
 

Requirements

 
This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.
 
Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 
 
SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.
 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.
 

We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 

 
 

Essential experience

 
 
We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems and care about building solutions that are robust, scalable and built to last. 
 
Experience in the following areas is important: 
  • Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouse, warehouse, notebooks and pipeline capabilities.  
  • Building enterprise-scale data platforms, lakehouses and data warehouses.  
  • Data modelling and dimensional modelling techniques such as Kimball. 
  • ETL/ELT development and large-scale data integration.  
  • PySpark, Spark SQL and modern transformation techniques.  
  • Advanced SQL and relational databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Oracle. 
  • Integrating structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources.  
  • Migration and modernisation of legacy platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server/SSIS or Synapse.  
  • Power BI semantic models, curated datasets and supporting analytics platforms. 
  • Data quality, governance, metadata management and lineage. 
  • Data security, classification and access control approaches. 
  • Automated testing, validation, reconciliation testing and performance optimisation. 
  • DataOps, CI/CD and version control practices.  
  • Agile delivery environments. 
 

Essential consulting skills

 
 

Our clients look to us for more than technical delivery. 

 

Success in this role comes from being able to navigate ambiguity, solve difficult problems and help clients make confident technical decisions. The strongest consultants combine technical expertise with curiosity, pragmatism and a collaborative mindset. 

 

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy: 

  • Solving complex engineering challenges and exploring different approaches to finding the right solution.  

  • Influencing technical direction through expertise, evidence and constructive challenge.  

  • Working closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand underlying problems rather than simply implement requirements.  

  • Balancing engineering quality, governance, security and reliability with business outcomes.  

  • Sharing knowledge, mentoring others and helping raise engineering standards.  

  • Building trusted relationships with clients and acting as a technical advisor.  

  • Keeping pace with emerging technologies and evaluating new approaches where they can add value.  

  • Contributing to a growing engineering capability while remaining close to delivery and technology. 

 

 

Salary

 
£61,000 - £70,000 per annum.
 

What we offer


A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work


This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you


We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview


Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.
 

Want to know more?  


Visit our website or email

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, hinterfragst Zahlen und weißt, wann eine Kampagne bereit für mehr Budget ist? Dann gestalte mit uns das nächste Wachstumskapitel von Nigela.

Das sind wir

Nigela ist unsere E-Commerce-Marke rund um Schwarzkümmel. Wir verbinden spezialisierte Produkte mit eigener frischer Ölpressung und einer starken Präsenz auf Social Media.

Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir jemanden, der unser Performance-Marketing aktiv vorantreibt: mit starken Creatives, systematischen Tests und einem klaren Blick auf wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern sowie unseren Teams und Partnern aus Influencer-Marketing, Content und Design zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen schnell in die Umsetzung kommen – und messbar etwas bewegen.

Aufgaben

  • Meta Ads steuern: Du planst, erstellst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram und verantwortest die operative Budgetsteuerung innerhalb vereinbarter Ziele.
  • Profitabel wachsen: Du bewertest Kampagnen anhand von Neukundenkosten, Umsatz und Profitabilität. Dabei ordnest du Plattformzahlen im Gesamtbild unseres Shops ein.
  • Creatives systematisch testen: Du entwickelst neue Hooks, Botschaften und Werbeansätze, schreibst klare Briefings und leitest aus den Ergebnissen die nächsten Tests ab.
  • Creator-Inhalte skalieren: Gemeinsam mit unserem Influencer-Marketing identifizierst du vielversprechende Inhalte und entwickelst sie zu erfolgreichen Partnership Ads weiter.
  • Die Customer Journey verbessern: Du analysierst den Weg von der Anzeige bis zum Kauf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team passende Angebote und Landingpage-Tests.
  • Zahlen verständlich machen: Du erstellst klare Auswertungen, erkennst Auffälligkeiten im Tracking und übersetzt Daten in konkrete Entscheidungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit voranbringen: Du koordinierst Tests mit internen Teams und externen Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass Erkenntnisse umgesetzt werden.

Qualifikation

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing für E-Commerce- oder D2C-Marken, idealerweise mindestens zwei Jahre.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Meta Ads Manager und Erfahrung mit eigenständig betreuten Kampagnen und Budgets.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für verkaufsstarke Creatives: Du kannst erklären, welche Zielgruppe eine Anzeige anspricht, warum der Einstieg funktioniert und was du als Nächstes testen würdest.
  • Analytisches Denken: Begriffe wie CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate, Warenkorbwert und Deckungsbeitrag sind dir vertraut.
  • Erfahrung mit strukturierten Tests und der Fähigkeit, aus Ergebnissen nachvollziehbare Schlüsse zu ziehen.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du bringst Ideen ein, setzt sie um und kommunizierst klar, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Bewertung und Entwicklung unserer Werbeinhalte.

Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrung mit Shopify, getKlar, Partnership Ads, UGC, Landingpage-Optimierung oder Google Ads mit. Kenntnisse in mehreren dieser Bereiche sind uns besonders wichtig, da sie deine tägliche Arbeit bei uns prägen werden.

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Verantwortung für einen wichtigen Wachstumsbereich unserer Marke.
  • Eine enge Verbindung von Influencer-Marketing, Content und Paid Social.
  • Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und ihre Wirkung direkt zu sehen.
  • Ein physisches Produkt und Einblicke in die Herstellung hinter der Marke.
  • Weitere Benefits: Mitarbeiter Rabatt, WellPass Mitgliedschaft

Pipeline Generation & Outbound

jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As Senior/Expert HR Tech Solution Architect, you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape.

Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.

You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within.

This role is based in Munich, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.  

About the Role

  • Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.
  • Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization.
  • Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures.
  • Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations.
  • Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live.

About You

  • 8+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field.
  • Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage.
  • Demonstrable experience driving Workday transformations, including major Workday redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise Workday experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator.
  • Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments.
  • Experience with cloud architecture and AI & automation technologies is critical, including areas such as Claude/GenAI deployment, MCPs, n8n and Rovo Agents, alongside strong Jira project-management capabilities.
  • Fluency in English. Certifications in solution/enterprise architecture, project management, agile or automation (e.g. TOGAF, PMP, SAFe, Scrum, Six Sigma, n8n) are a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
FlixTrain ist die Challenger-Marke im deutschen Fernverkehr: grün, mutig und anders als der Platzhirsch. Auf Social Media wollen wir genau das zeigen, nicht als Kanäle, die „auch noch mitlaufen", sondern als eigenständige Bühne, auf der unsere Marke für digital-first Zielgruppen erlebbar wird. 

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d), der Organic Social bei FlixTrain weiterdenkt. Einige Kanäle laufen schon, aber ohne eigene Handschrift. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du machst aus mitlaufenden Kanälen eine eigenständige FlixTrain-Präsenz. Du bekommst einen Startpunkt mit Reichweite, aber freie Hand beim Aufbau von Strategie, Struktur, Prozessen und Partner-Setup. Du entscheidest, wo wir spielen und wo nicht, übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformgerecht und machst Wirkung messbar. Die Rolle ist Teil des Brand Teams und bewusst als eigenverantwortliche Aufbaurolle angelegt: Du bist In-House-Kopf und Taktgeber, die Produktion steuerst du über Agentur, Creator und internes Creative Team. 

Entscheidend ist eine Haltung: Nähe zum Zeitgeist, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen. Wir wollen Reichweite mit Substanz: Content, der zur Marke passt, nicht bloße Content-Masse. 

Über die Rolle 

Strategie & Where-to-play 

  • Du entwickelst die Organic-Social-Strategie für FlixTrain: klare Ziele, Zielgruppen und Kommunikations-Säulen: abgeleitet aus der übergeordneten Markenstrategie, nicht als Insel. 
  • Du triffst die Where-to-play-Entscheidung: Du prüfst die bestehenden Kanäle, entscheidest, welche wir fokussieren und welche bewusst nicht, und identifizierst, wo FlixTrain zusätzlich präsent sein sollte. 
  • Du definierst das Zusammenspiel aus „Big Moment"-Ideen (große, reichweitenstarke Momente, die kulturelle Relevanz schaffen) und Ongoing-Community-Content (kontinuierlich, näher an der bestehenden Community)  

Markenübersetzung & Content 

  • Du übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformnativ – nicht als adaptierten Kampagnen-Cutdown, sondern als eigenständige, kanaltypische Formate, die organisch wirken statt „gebrandet". 
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Content zum Zeitgeist UND zur Marke passt: Du kombinierst Entertainment- und Kultur-Trends mit echtem Markenfit – kein Trend-Hopping, kein „AI-Slop", kein Content um des Contents willen. 
  • Du betreibst Community Management, hältst die Marke im Dialog präsent und behältst auch bei kritischen Themen einen souveränen Ton – mit dem Gespür, wann ein Fall an PR gehört. 

Partner- & Produktions-Setup 

  • Du baust das richtige Partner-Setup auf und steuerst es. Darüber hinaus managst du das Budget eigenverantwortlich und entscheidest, welche Inhalte gezielt verstärkt werden. 

Measurement & Wirkung 

  • Du machst die Wirkung von Organic Social mit den richtigen KPIs je Zielstellung und Maßnahme messbar — von Big-Moment Content bis hin zu Ongoing-Content — und etablierst ein durchdachtes Reporting, aus dem du gezielt Learnings für die nächste Planungsrunde ableitest. 

Stakeholder & Schnittstellen 

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team, dem FlixBus Social Media Team und dem Creative Team zusammen und sorgst für strategische Konsistenz zwischen Organic, Paid und Kampagne. 
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner und vertrittst Social souverän gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen. 

Über Dich 

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Organic-Social- bzw. Content-Marketing – idealerweise mit Erfahrung auf Unternehmens- und Agenturseite. 
  • Du bist Generalist: Du denkst strategisch (Where-to-play, KPIs, Positionierung) und bleibst gleichzeitig hands-on in Redaktionsplanung, Briefing und Steuerung. 
  • Du hast Social-Strukturen oder -Kanäle aufgebaut oder maßgeblich geprägt, nicht nur verwaltet – du bringst Ownership und Aufbau-Mentalität mit. 
  • Du bist nah am Zeitgeist und kannst Entertainment-/Kultur-Trends lesen – aber mit dem Urteilsvermögen, sie am Markenfit zu messen und auch Nein zu sagen. 
  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Creator und Freelancer sicher und behältst Budget, Timings und Qualität im Blick. 
  • Du nutzt KPIs, Social Listening und Insights selbstverständlich als Grundlage von Entscheidungen – und erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Reichweite und Wirkung. 
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (jeweils mind. C1-Niveau). 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, hier etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. 

Was Wir Bieten 

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. 
  • Arbeiten von überall: Je nach Rolle bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus. 
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Bürokultur mit Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. 
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Maßnahmen zur Stressbewältigung – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. 
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. 
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. 

 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Clariness is looking for an AI Security Engineer (f/m/d) based Germany, UK, SA, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about building, operating and continuously improving Clariness' security capabilities across applications, cloud infrastructure and AI systems. As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment.

As an AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Defining Clariness' security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling.
  • Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Owning AI security and governance across LLM-powered features, RAG systems and agentic pipelines, including assessing and mitigating risks covered by the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems.
  • Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence.
  • Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness' requirements.
  • Managing Clariness' IT security compliance programme—including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls—while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance.

We would like you to have: 

  • At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities.
  • Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire.
  • Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls.
  • Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors.
  • Experience in a regulated industry such as clinical research, pharmaceuticals, healthtech or fintech, with knowledge of GxP or comparable regulated data-handling requirements considered a strong advantage, alongside strong English communication skills at C1 level.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

 

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview →  Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

Clariness GmbH will treat the above information strictly confidential and will especially observe the applicable provisions of the applicable data protection laws. Further information about the use of the applicant data, you will find in the data protection declaration online at https://www.clariness.com/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

This role is remote-first. [please fill with specific location / timezone requirements].

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments (ECC, S/4HANA) or procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

jobs.title: System Engineer (all genders) Datacenter Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle motion für ganzheitliche IT-Lösungen rund um Managed Services, Modern Workplace und skalierbare Infrastrukturen. Zur Verstärkung unseres dreiköpfigen Datacenter-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Verstärkung für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datacenter-Infrastruktur – von Servern und Storage über Netzwerkkomponenten bis zur Grundkonfiguration der Systeme

  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung der virtualisierten Infrastruktur mit verschiedenen Hypervisors wie ESXi, Hyper-V und KVM sowie Betreuung der zugrunde liegenden Microsoft- und Linux-Systeme

  • Bedarfsgerechte Skalierung der physischen Infrastruktur auf Basis von Monitoring, Metriken und technischen Auswertungen

  • Automatisierung von Betriebs- und Konfigurationsaufgaben mit Ansible sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung und Standardisierung bestehender Abläufe

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Server-, Storage-, Netzwerk- und Backup-Umgebungen, unter anderem mit Dell, Aruba und Veeam

  • Planung und technische Begleitung von Migrationen und Infrastrukturprojekten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachteams

  • Bewertung technischer Anforderungen und Machbarkeit im Angebotsprozess gemeinsam mit PreSales sowie Entwicklung passender Infrastruktur-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit IT- oder Rechenzentrumsinfrastrukturen und fundiertes Know-how in Server, Storage und Netzwerk mit

  • Du fühlst dich in Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen zuhause und konfigurierst Netzwerk-, Server- und Storage-Komponenten sicher

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung, z. B. VMware oder Hyper-V, und idealerweise auch mit Backup-Lösungen wie Veeam

  • Du automatisierst bereits mit Ansible oder hast Lust, dich künftig noch stärker mit Automatisierung zu beschäftigen

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, triffst technische Entscheidungen und bringst Teamgeist sowie Neugier auf neue Technologien mit

  • Du hast einen Führerschein der Klasse B und freust dich auf durchschnittlich ein bis zwei Einsätze pro Monat in unseren Rechenzentren, insbesondere in Nürnberg

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Nabburg und Umgebung und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

jobs.title: Teckenspråkskunnig elevassistent till Tybblelundsskolan
jobs.description:
Vill du bli en del av ett kompetent team som tillsammans arbetar för att ge eleverna deras bästa möjliga skolgång? Vi på Tybblelundsskolan söker nu en teckenspråkskunnig elevassistent som vill bidra till att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en elev i årskurs 5. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om tjänsten

Som teckenspråkskunnig elevassistent kommer du att finnas med under skoldagen som stöd för en elev och skolans personal. Du kommer att medverka i undervisningssituationer som tolkande teckenspråkskunnig elevassistent samt vid samtal med vårdnadshavare som tolk. Du kommer att samarbeta med undervisande lärare samt elevhälsan.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    vara resurs med tolkuppdrag för en elev under lektioner, raster och andra situationer under skoldagen
    ge nära stöd för en elev och personal

Om arbetsplatsen

Tybblelundsskolan ligger sydost om Örebro stadskärna i närheten av Örebro universitet och ligger granne med Tybblelundshallen. Det är en treparallelig grundskola för elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 6. I dagsläget har vi ca 530 elever och 70 personal. I varje årskurs arbetar ett arbetslag nära eleverna med undervisning och fritidsverksamhet. Läs mer om skolan på vår hemsida: https://www.orebro.se/tybblelundsskolan.

Inom Förskole- och grundskoleförvaltningen arbetar cirka 4530 medarbetare. Vi möter de unga örebroarna från första dagen i förskolan till sista dagen i grundskolan. 







Vi ansvarar tillsammans för att bidra till att skapa likvärdiga förutsättningar för de unga örebroarna och lägger grunden till ett lärande som sträcker sig genom hela livet. Med tillit och mod bygger vi våra förskolor och skolor tillsammans. Vi tar oss an framtidens utmaningar, för varje barns bästa.



Kvalifikationer

För att kunna vara ett bra stöd i ditt arbete krävs att du kan använda svenska språket och svenskt teckenspråk separat i skilda situationer, att du kan växla mellan språken i ett gemensamt sammanhang och att du har en känsla för när det ena, respektive det andra, språket bör användas.

Som elevassistent är du noggrann och självständig i ditt arbete. För att lyckas i tjänsten är det viktigt att du tycker att det är intressant att träffa olika typer av individer och att du trivs med en flexibel arbetssituation. Självklart har du en positiv elevsyn och ett stort genuint intresse av att arbeta med våra elever.

Vidare behärskar du det svenska språket på så sätt att du kan kommunicera med barn, vårdnadshavare och övrig personal, samt skriftligt dokumentera det som verksamheten kräver. För att kunna dokumentera krävs även god datavana.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Krav:
