jobs.title: Butiksansvarig till Percys Kött i Täby Park 23 h/v
jobs.description:
Percys Kött är ett livsmedelsföretag med lång erfarenhet och stor kunskap inom kött, chark och delikatesser. Till vår butik på Boulevarden i Täby Park söker vi nu en serviceinriktad och ansvarstagande butiksmedarbetare som vill bli en del av Percys Kött.

Rollen passar både dig som har lång erfarenhet från service och livsmedel och dig som har rätt grund och vill utveckla dina kunskaper inom delikatess och färskvaror.

Om tjänsten

I butiken möter du våra kunder och hjälper dem att hitta rätt bland vårt sortiment. Här är den personliga servicen viktig – många kunder uppskattar tips, inspiration och hjälp inför både vardagsmiddagen och helgens måltider.

Du kommer efter introduktion att arbeta mycket självständigt och ansvara för den dagliga driften under dina arbetspass.

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:

    

Försäljning och personlig kundservice

    

Kassaarbete

    

Påfyllning och exponering av varor

    

Hålla butiken ren, välfylld och inspirerande

    

Ta emot och hantera leveranser

    

Öppning och stängning av butiken

    

Enklare förberedelser inför försäljning

Beroende på din tidigare erfarenhet får du introduktion och upplärning i vårt sortiment och våra arbetssätt. För dig som vill utvecklas finns möjlighet att lära dig mer om kött, chark, delikatesser och hantering av färskvaror.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt dig som tycker om människor, mat och service.

Du kan vara en erfaren butiks- eller delikatessmedarbetare som uppskattar ett självständigt deltidsarbete, men du kan också vara tidigare café- eller restaurangmedarbetare som vill ta steget över till butik och lära dig mer om delikatesser och färskvaror.

Erfarenhet från något av följande är särskilt relevant:

    

Livsmedelsbutik

    

Delikatess eller öppna färskvaror

    

Kött och chark

    

Café

    

Restaurang eller kök

    

Annan försäljning och service

Du behöver alltså inte redan vara expert på kött och delikatesser. Har du rätt inställning, ett genuint intresse för mat och viljan att lära dig kan vi hjälpa dig att utveckla produktkunskapen.

Eftersom du efter introduktionen kommer att arbeta mycket självständigt är det viktigt att du är pålitlig, ansvarstagande och initiativrik. Du ser vad som behöver göras och tycker om att skapa en butik som kunderna gärna kommer tillbaka till.

Arbetstider

Tjänsten omfattar cirka 23 timmar per vecka, fördelat på fyra fasta dagar:

Onsdag: 12.00–18.00 Torsdag: 12.30–18.00 Fredag: ca 12.30–18.00 Lördag: 09.30–15.00

Det här är ett stabilt deltidsupplägg med tydliga arbetstider och ledighet söndag–tisdag.

Arbetsplats: Percys Kött, Boulevarden 24, Täby Park Omfattning: Deltid, cirka 23 timmar/vecka Lön: Enligt kollektivavtal samt 5 kr/timme i ansvarstillägg Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan

Låter det som något för dig?

Skicka in ditt CV och berätta gärna kort om dig själv, din tidigare erfarenhet och varför du skulle vilja arbeta hos Percys Kött.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – för oss är rätt inställning, ansvarskänsla och viljan att lära sig minst lika viktigt som tidigare erfarenhet.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas så snart vi hittar rätt person.

jobs.title: Machinist Rupskraan | Stabroek
jobs.description:
BEDRIJFSVOORSTELLING

Al sinds de jaren 60 is Aertssen Group dé referentie voor bouw- en infrastructuurprojecten, complexe hijswerken, uitzonderlijke transportservices en wereldwijde logistieke dienstverlening voor mijn- en (land)bouwmachines. Als internationale speler met talrijke vestigingen in België, het Midden-Oosten en de Verenigde Staten, verliest dit familiebedrijf zijn hart voor mensen geen seconde uit het oog. Bouwen aan de allermooiste projecten met ongelimiteerde passie voor mensen en machines: daarvoor geven we bij Aertssen elke dag opnieuw het beste van onszelf.
Duurzaamheid staat bij ons centraal: zo investeren we in een modern en energiezuinig wagenpark, zetten we in op hernieuwbare energie op onze sites, en stimuleren we circulair bouwen door maximaal in te zetten op recyclage van materialen.


Aertssen Group, dat is People, Power and Passion, to Build On! Deze overtuiging werd bekrachtigd door de verkiezing als Onderneming van het Jaar 2021 en ons Best Managed Companies-label.

Wat wordt je nieuwe baan?
  • Als Machinist ga je dagelijks aan de slag met een rupskraan van 160 tot 600 ton.
  • Je staat in voor de vlotte & veilige uitvoering van hijswerken in diverse sectoren (windmolens, bouwwerven, bruggen e.a.).
  • Je komt op verschillende werven in gans het land of over de grenzen heen (Nederland, Frankrijk, Luxemburg en Duitsland).
  • Je maakt deel uit van een team dat samenwerkt om de hijswerken tot een goed einde te brengen.
  • Je waakt over een veilige manier van werken.

Welke kwaliteiten verwachten we?

  • Je beschikt over een identiteitskaart/verblijfsvergunning.
  • Je bent medisch geschikt om te werken.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs C.
  • Je werkt goed samen in een team en durft verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen.
  • Je houdt ervan om met grote machines te rijden en te werken.
  • Je voelt je goed in een afwisselende job met flexibele uren.
  • Het is een pluspunt als je beschikt over een of meerdere van de volgende attesten: VCA Basis/VCA VOL, IS-001, IS-003, IS-005, IS-006, AV-006, IS-011, AV-013, AV-015, IS-031, IS-032, TCVT en Code 95.
  • Ervaring is een must!

jobs.title: Allround medewerker Horeca/Fastfood
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap als leidinggevende? Zoek je een job met veel doorgroeimogelijkheden, een hecht team en de zekerheid van een stabiele werkgever? Dan hebben wij dé kans voor jou!

In deze functie stuur je het team aan tijdens jouw shift. Je zorgt dat alles soepel loopt: van een vlotte service tot tevreden klanten. Samen met je collega’s bouw je mee aan een positieve werksfeer én aan jouw toekomst. Je krijgt volop kansen om door te groeien richting hogere managementrollen.

Waarom is dit dé job voor jou?

  • Je zet je leidinggevende skills in én bouwt ze verder uit.
  • Je werkt in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat.
  • Je krijgt begeleiding en kansen om door te groeien.

Als shiftmanager start je in de functie van 'gewone' medewerker voor ongeveer een maand, om de flow te leren kennen, daarna start je aan jouw opleidingstraject als shiftmanager. Ongeveer een half jaar een examen in NL later ben je klaar om jouw rol op te nemen.

Als shiftmanager stuur jij samen met een collega shiftmanager een team van 25 mensen aan. Jullie krijgen de planning een maand op voorhand door.

Doorheen de dag lossen jullie problemen op in het team of met klanten. Belangrijk dus om communicatief sterk in jouw schoenen te staan.

Je werkt in vaste uurblokken die zich situeren tussen 8u 's morgens en 01.00u 's avonds.

  • Je bent communicatief zeer sterk en weet hoe je een team moet aansturen. People management ligt jou.
  • Je bent flexibel in werktijden, zowel in avondwerk als weekendwerk.
  • Je bent klaar om te groeien, zowel als persoon als in functie.

jobs.description:
BEDRIJFSVOORSTELLING

Al sinds de jaren 60 is Aertssen Group dé referentie voor bouw- en infrastructuurprojecten, complexe hijswerken, uitzonderlijke transportservices en wereldwijde logistieke dienstverlening voor mijn- en (land)bouwmachines. Als internationale speler met talrijke vestigingen in België, het Midden-Oosten en de Verenigde Staten, verliest dit familiebedrijf zijn hart voor mensen geen seconde uit het oog. Bouwen aan de allermooiste projecten met ongelimiteerde passie voor mensen en machines: daarvoor geven we bij Aertssen elke dag opnieuw het beste van onszelf.
Duurzaamheid staat bij ons centraal: zo investeren we in een modern en energiezuinig wagenpark, zetten we in op hernieuwbare energie op onze sites, en stimuleren we circulair bouwen door maximaal in te zetten op recyclage van materialen.


Aertssen Group, dat is People, Power and Passion, to Build On! Deze overtuiging werd bekrachtigd door de verkiezing als Onderneming van het Jaar 2021 en ons Best Managed Companies-label.

Wat wordt je nieuwe baan?

  • Als Machinist Mobiele Hijskraan ga je dagelijks aan de slag met een mobiele hijskraan of rupskraan van 40 tot 750 ton.
  • Je staat in voor de vlotte & veilige uitvoering van hijswerken bij diverse klanten (bouwwerven, petrochemie e.a.).
  • Je rijdt met een hijskraan naar verschillende werven in gans het land.
  • Vaak word je ondersteund en begeleid door één of meerdere riggers voor het plaatsen en manipuleren van diverse lasten.
  • Je waakt over een veilige manier van werken.

Welke kwaliteiten verwachten we?

  • Je beschikt over een identiteitskaart/verblijfsvergunning.
  • Je bent medisch geschikt om te werken.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs C.
  • Je werkt goed samen in een team en durft verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen.
  • Je houdt ervan om met grote machines te werken.
  • Je voelt je goed in een afwisselende job met flexibele uren.
  • Ervaring is zeker een meerwaarde!
  • Het is een pluspunt als je beschikt over een of meerdere van de volgende attesten: VCA Basis/VCA VOL, IS-001, IS-003, IS-005, IS-006, AV-006, IS-011, AV-013, AV-015, IS-031, IS-032, TCVT en Code 95.

jobs.title: Shiftleader voeding
jobs.description:
Functie

Voor onze klant, een fastfoodbedrijf, kijken we uit naar een shiftleader.

Ben jij leergierig, enthousiast en klaar om de kneepjes van het vak vanaf de grond af aan te leren?

In de eerste fase draai je volledig mee op de werkvloer. Zo weet je precies hoe het er in de praktijk aan toe gaat en bouw je de ideale basis op om straks jouw team optimaal aan te sturen.

Zodra je het operationele werk helemaal onder de knie hebt, stroom je officieel door naar de functie van Shiftleader en neem je de leiding op de werkvloer.

Jouw taken als Shiftleader:

  • Je leidt de shift, verdeelt de taken en zorgt voor een prettige en energieke samenwerking.
  • Je let erop dat alle producten aan de hoogste eisen voldoen en dat elke gast met een glimlach vertrekt.
  • Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe collega’s, zodat zij snel en vol zelfvertrouwen meedraaien.
  • Je zorgt voor een schone, opgeruimde en veilige werkomgeving voor het hele team.
  • Je koppelt de voortgang en eventuele knelpunten tijdens jouw shift helder terug aan de restaurantmanager.
Profiel
  • Je hebt ervaring in de horeca, voeding of retail en bent toe aan (een volgende stap in) een leidinggevende rol.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, een proactieve en positieve werkhouding en een natuurlijke leiderschapsstijl.
  • Je bent klantgericht en streeft altijd naar de beste service.
  • Je bent flexibel qua werktijden en vindt het geen probleem om ’s avonds of in het weekend te werken.
  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels.
Wat je van ons krijgt
  • Voltijdse functie (38u/week) in een flexibel rooster
  • Mooi uurloon aangevuld met premies (zondag, eventueel nacht,..)
  • €250 Ecocheques per jaar
.

jobs.title: Servicesamordnare
jobs.description:
Är du en strukturerad och serviceinriktad person som trivs med högt tempo, många kontaktytor och att ha flera saker på gång samtidigt? Nu söker vi en servicesamordnare till ett väl etablerat familjeägt VVS-bolag i Göteborg.

Här är det viktigare att du är duktig på kundservice, administration och struktur än att du kan mycket om VVS. Branschkunskapen lär du dig på plats.

Bolaget har funnits i cirka 50 år och drivs idag i tredje generationen. Verksamheten finns på flera orter runt om i landet och för några år sedan startades även en filial i Göteborg. Filialen har utvecklats väl och har en god orderstock.

Om rollen

Som servicesamordnare är du en av de första personerna kunden kommer i kontakt med. Du sitter på frontline och tar emot inkommande samtal och mejl från både privatpersoner och företag i Göteborg med omnejd.

Din uppgift är att förstå vad kunden behöver, ge ett bra första bemötande och se till att rätt VVS-montör bokas in för jobbet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    Ta emot inkommande samtal från privatpersoner och företag
    Besvara och hantera inkommande mejl
    Vara första kontakt med kunden och ge professionell kundservice
    Planera och koordinera montörernas jobb
    Skapa och administrera ordrar
    Hålla ordning på ärenden och följa upp att de blir hanterade
    Hantera enklare fakturering

Vi söker dig som

Framför allt söker vi dig som är strukturerad, serviceinriktad och trivs med att ha många bollar i luften.

    Har god kundservice och tycker om att ha kontakt med människor
    Är strukturerad och gillar ordning och reda
    Har god datorvana
    Kan hantera flera saker samtidigt utan att tappa kontrollen
    Tar ansvar för att saker blir gjorda och följs upp

Du behöver inte ha någon tidigare erfarenhet av VVS branschen och inte heller ha arbetat i några specifika system. Det viktiga är att du har rätt egenskaper. System och rutiner lärs du upp på plats.

En familjär arbetsplats

Bolaget präglas av en familjär stämning och en platt organisation. Det är korta beslutsvägar och nära mellan medarbetare och ledning.

Bolaget är ISO-certifierat och har funnits i branschen i omkring 50 år. Med verksamhet på flera orter, en etablerad Göteborgsfilial och en fortsatt god orderstock är det en stabil arbetsgivare med långsiktiga ambitioner.

Övrigt

    Kollektivavtal
    Konkurrenskraftig lön
    Familjärt och tryggt bolag

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Technical Compliance Officer - Malta
jobs.description:
The business supplies a live casino platform and content into multiple regulated markets, each with its own technical standards, certification scheme and evidentiary expectations. The Technical Compliance Officer - Certifications translates those obligations into testable technical requirements, owns the certification lifecycle end to end - readiness, submission, findings closure, surveillance and recertification - and is the primary interface with accredited test laboratories, certification bodies and regulatory authorities.

As a second-line role it does not operate first-line controls. It defines the compliance position in technical terms, tests whether the evidence supports that position, and reports certification risk with proposed treatment.

Purpose

Certification and technical standards obligations across the licence portfolio, currently Malta (MGA), Isle of Man (GSC) and Curacao (CGA), and all certification engagements with accredited test laboratories. Scope extends to new markets as the licence footprint grows.

Main Responsibilities

Regulatory Research and Technical Translation

    Maintain a current view of the technical standards, certification schemes and regulatory instruments applying to a B2B platform and content supplier in each market in scope
    Translate regulatory text into testable technical requirements and control objectives that first-line teams can act on without further interpretation
    Run gap analyses against current posture and issue risk-ranked remediation plans naming the deliverables required to close

Requirement-to-Control Traceability

    Maintain traceability from each regulatory requirement to the control that satisfies it and the artefact that evidences it, across all jurisdictions in scope
    Keep the mapping current as requirements, controls and platform architecture change, so that certification questions are answered from the register rather than reconstructed under time pressure
    Validate mapping completeness ahead of each certification milestone and resolve unmapped or unevidenced requirements with the first line before submission

Certification and Audit Management

    Maintain a forward certification calendar by standard, jurisdiction and certified asset, sequenced against commercial expansion plans and licence renewal dates
    Run pre-audit readiness assessments and assemble submission packs - technical documentation, control evidence and test results - to the standard each body expects
    Act as primary point of contact for certification bodies and regulatory authorities, managing scope, queries, timelines, proposals and invoicing
    Track findings and non-conformities through to verified closure, and manage surveillance, change notification and recertification obligations

Regulatory Change Management

    Assess the technical impact of regulatory and scheme changes on the control environment, the certified asset base and existing certifications
    Issue impact assessments stating what has changed, which controls and assets are affected, what must be done and by when
    Maintain traceability from notification through to implementation and evidence, so that the position taken on any change can be reconstructed and defended

Risk Reporting and Cross-Functional Support

    Own certification and technical compliance entries in the compliance risk register as an independent second-line assessment of exposure, treatment and status
    Report certification risk and readiness to the compliance forum with proposed treatment, escalating where evidence gaps or timelines put a licence or a market at risk
    Brief first-line teams on the jurisdiction-specific requirements bearing on their work, and support new market entry with technical feasibility assessments and realistic certification timelines

Key Relationships

    First line: Product, Engineering, Integrations, DevOps and Studio Operations
    Second line: Regulatory and Technical Compliance, Governance, Legal and Data Protection
    External: accredited test laboratories, certification bodies and regulatory authorities

Main Requirements

    Minimum two years in gaming or iGaming, ideally B2B, supporting a portfolio of certified products and platforms; live studio exposure an advantage
    Direct dealings with accredited test laboratories and certification bodies across readiness, submission, findings tracking and closure
    A record of translating regulatory or scheme requirements into technical requirements that first-line teams could implement
    Managing certification and compliance gaps through to evidenced closure, including remediation planning and follow-up
    Multi-jurisdictional B2B licensing exposure across three or more regulated markets
    ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS operation, control design and evidence practice
    Working understanding of RNG and game certification, live studio technical standards and platform architecture

Skills and attributes

    Precise analytical reading of regulatory text, clear on what is mandatory, what is recommended and what is interpretation
    Structured writing - requirements, gap analyses, impact assessments and audit correspondence that stand up to external scrutiny
    Organised across parallel certification timelines, and able to hold a defensible position with external bodies and internal stakeholders
    Comfortable using AI tools for research, analysis and documentation, with the judgement to verify output before relying on it
    A second-line mindset: evidence over assertion, and independence from the activity being assessed
    Education and certifications
    Degree in business, management or computer science, or equivalent professional experience - ideal
    ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer - beneficial

CISA, CRISC or equivalent - advantageous

What’s in it for you?

    Experience a dynamic and team-orientated work environment
    Opportunities for personal growth and learning
    An open, inclusive and supportive team where you will be valued, and your suggestions will be welcome
    24 days paid holiday per year, in addition to local public holidays
    Birthday Leave, a paid day off in the month of your birthday
    Competitive Salary
    Hybrid Working (3 days office/2 days home)
    Risk Benefits such as Private Medical Insurance and Life Assurance (2x annual salary)
    Annual Wellness Allowance
    Team Building Opportunities
    Monthly Lunch Allowance
    Parking (limited)
    Local discounts and more…
    Our team is committed to keeping remuneration and benefits under constant review to make sure what we offer stays relevant.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect (Remote Worldwide)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Enterprise Architect to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

- Lead large-scale digital transformation projects for manufacturing organizations, from vision to execution

- Define and implement enterprise architecture frameworks that connect cloud, edge, IoT/IIoT, data analytics, and AI/ML ecosystems

- Translate business strategy into actionable technology roadmaps aligned with scalability, performance, and cost efficiency

- Ensure architecture meets the highest standards for security, compliance, and governance across all layers

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align business, data, application, and infrastructure architectures

- Guide stakeholders through architecture decisions, balancing innovation with operational excellence

- Mentor and coach teams, fostering a culture of architecture discipline, innovation, and continuous improvement

Requirements

We want to hear from you if you have:

- 10+ years of experience in IT architecture roles

- Experience with Azure and GCP

- Deep expertise in cloud, edge computing, IoT/IIoT, data analytics, and AI/ML platform

- Strong knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks (ISO, GDPR, etc.)

- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; capable of influencing at all levels

- Experience working in global, distributed teams

- Strategic thinker with hands-on experience designing and integrating complex enterprise systems

Benefits

Perks of being one of us:

    Flexible work setup: work fully remotely from any country in the EU on a freelance/B2B contract, or join our Sofia, Bulgaria office under a local employment contract that offers a comprehensive social welfare package.
    Autonomy: an environment where your technical vision matters, and you own your work-life balance.

How to Apply / What Happens Next:

1. Send us your CV by hitting the “Apply” button.

2. You will hear from one of our Global Talent Connectors within 5 business days with the next steps.

3. Meet us on MS Teams and tell us what excites you.

5. Along this journey and depending on the role you are applying for, prepare to meet either our Chief Talent Gaucho, your future leader or our Head Honcho!

jobs.title: Controller med teamledaransvar till en större offentligt ägd koncern
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren controller som vill leda ett team på tre controllers och bidra operativt till organisationens förändringsresa? Då kan det här spännande konsultuppdraget vara din nästa utmaning!

Om uppdraget Uppdragsgivaren är en av Sveriges största offentligägda koncerner med ett omfattande och samhällskritiskt uppdrag. Organisationen befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas och söker nu en engagerad och erfaren controller som vill bidra med expertis och stabilitet under en pågående förändringsresa.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med start så snart som möjligt. Uppdraget beräknas pågå under cirka sex månader, med möjlighet till förlängning. Arbetet bedrivs i huvudsak från verksamhetens kontor i centrala Stockholm.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Rollen kombinerar strategiskt ledarskap med ett operativt ”hands-on” arbetssätt. I uppdraget ingår teamledaransvar för tre controllers, vilket innebär att arbetsleda, stötta och samordna gruppens dagliga arbete.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    

Ansvara för den övergripande ekonomistyrningen, vilket innefattar att strukturera, samordna och kvalitetssäkra verksamhetens finansiella processer och löpande controlling-funktioner

    

Stötta och leda teamets nuvarande controllers

    

Agera strategiskt beslutsstöd till ledning och chefer

    

Prognos och budget arbete i enighet med verksamhetens mål och politiska ramar

    

Ansvara för löpande analys och KPI-uppföljning

    

Bidra till effektivisering av ekonomistyrningen genom process och BI-utveckling, datakuber och automatiserade rapportverktyg

    

Ha ett nära samarbete med redovisningsfunktionen

    

Samverka med organisationens interna servicecenter

Dina kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen krävs en gedigen bakgrund inom offentlig ekonomi och erfarenhet av att navigera i politiskt styrda eller komplexa miljöer.

    

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av offentlig redovisning och ekonomistyrning

    

Gedigen erfarenhet av att arbeta som controller inom en större, komplex organisation

    

Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel samt erfarenhet av pivottabeller, datakuber och hantering av stora datamängder (Big Data)

    

Erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa, integrerade ekonomisystem

    

Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift

Meriterande

    

Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, alternativt annan utbildning kombinerat med yrkeserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig

    

Erfarenhet av koncernövergripande controlling (Group Controlling)

    

Tidigare formellt eller informellt personal- eller ledaransvar

    

Systemkännedom i Raindance

    

Erfarenhet av IBM Cognos Planning eller motsvarande beslutsstödssystem

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker en analytisk och strukturerad person med ett starkt lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Du arbetar effektivt, driver processer framåt och har en naturlig förmåga att leda och motivera andra.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

Som konsult hos Bemannia får du:

⭐ En nära kontakt med din konsultchef ⭐ Möjlighet till fler spännande uppdrag ⭐ Erfarenhet på lärorika arbetsplatser där din kompetens gör skillnad ⭐ Trygga anställningsvillkor

🔭 Läs mer om hur det är att vara konsult hos oss här: Att jobba som konsult via Bemannia

Om ansökan

jobs.title: Genesys Cloud Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Genesys Cloud Engineer to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

    Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.
    Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.
    Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

    Design, develop, configure and maintain Genesys Cloud CX solutions for production contact center environments.
    Take technical ownership of Genesys Cloud solutions from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support.
    Design and implement IVR, inbound and outbound call flows using Genesys Architect, with a focus on scalable, maintainable and reusable solutions.
    Design and implement AI-powered IVR and virtual agent solutions, enabling customers to interact with conversational AI through voice and other channels.
    Design and implement automated and AI-powered outbound campaigns, including predictive/progressive dialing, automated customer outreach, campaign segmentation, call strategies and intelligent follow-up workflows.
    Work with omnichannel campaign capabilities, including voice, email, SMS and other supported digital communication channels.
    Architect and configure ACD, routing, queues, skills, users, permissions and contact center workflows according to business and technical requirements.
    Investigate and resolve complex production issues, providing L2/L3 support where required and taking ownership through to resolution and follow-up.
    Troubleshoot Genesys Cloud, SIP, RTP, VoIP, DNS and networking issues, working with infrastructure, network and application engineering teams when required.
    Translate business and operational requirements into technical designs, solution architectures and Genesys Cloud implementations.
    Contribute to the design of customer-specific solutions and participate in technical discussions with customers, engineers, architects and operational teams.
    Evaluate new Genesys Cloud AI, automation, outbound and digital capabilities and identify opportunities to incorporate them into customer solutions.
    Produce and maintain technical documentation including solution designs, architecture documentation, integration specifications, AI solution designs, campaign designs, configuration standards and knowledge-base materials.

Requirements

We want to hear from you if you have:

    5+ years of hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX or a closely related Genesys/contact center technology.
    Experience designing, developing, configuring and supporting production Genesys Cloud environments.
    Strong practical experience with Genesys Cloud Architect, including designing and troubleshooting complex IVR and call flows.
    Strong understanding of Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including Genesys Copilot, virtual agents and AI-powered customer and agent experiences.
    Understanding of omnichannel customer journeys spanning voice, email, SMS, digital channels, AI and human agents.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured approach to technical design and troubleshooting.
    Ability to take ownership of technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation and production support.
    Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.
    Genuine interest in developing further into Genesys architecture, AI, integrations, automation, outbound campaign solutions and intelligent contact center technologies.
    Strong advantages
    Experience building AI solutions that integrate with CRM systems, knowledge bases, APIs and backend applications.
    Good understanding of APIs, REST, JSON and OAuth, preferably in the context of Genesys Cloud.
    Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with CRM, marketing automation, customer-data platforms or other enterprise systems to drive automated campaigns.
    Experience with Salesforce or other CRM integrations.
    Genesys Cloud certification.
    Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure.

Benefits

Perks of being one of us:

    Flexible work setup: work fully remotely from any country in the EU on a freelance/B2B contract, or join our Sofia, Bulgaria office under a local employment contract that offers a comprehensive social welfare package.
    Autonomy: an environment where your technical vision matters, and you own your work-life balance.
    Growth: a personalized career development program to fuel your journey; learn from experts, expand your craft, and work across industries.
    Global vibe: an international, dynamic, remote-first workplace.
    Connectivity Support: home office allowance
    Total Rewards: paid time off and competitive remuneration.
    Community: team get-togethers and networking events are in our DNA!
    Seamless Living: need a base? Digitally check into a spacious room at our WN LAB Hotel, Bulgaria’s biggest and coolest 4★ co-living hotel. No deposit, with special discounted rates for single apartments starting from 660 EUR/month (utilities & cleaning included!).
    Be part of something beyond work: culture, values, impact.



How to Apply / What Happens Next:

1. Send us your CV by hitting the “Apply” button.

2. You will hear from one of our Global Talent Connectors within 5 business days with the next steps.

3. Meet us on MS Teams and tell us what excites you.

4. Next stage could be a test or a task - we want to see what you DO (not just what you say)

5. Along this journey and depending on the role you are applying for, prepare to meet either our Chief Talent Gaucho, your future leader or our Head Honcho!

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - Malta
jobs.description:
As a Senior QA Tester at Eeze, you will play a key role in driving both manual and automated quality assurance efforts across our live casino platforms. You will combine deep exploratory and functional testing expertise with hands-on test automation development to ensure our products are stable, scalable, and production-ready.

Beyond identifying and reporting defects, you will actively contribute to expanding automation coverage, improving testing efficiency, and strengthening quality standards across frontend and backend systems.

Through close collaboration with developers, QA leadership, and cross-functional teams, you will help embed quality into every stage of the development lifecycle and continuously elevate our overall testing practices.

Key Responsibilities:

Test Planning & Execution

    Design and execute manual test cases in Zephyr using Gherkin syntax.
    Test new features, game flows, and integrations for both frontend and backend.
    Perform cross-browser testing on desktop and mobile devices, including physical devices and BrowserStack.
    Conduct sanity and smoke tests on QA, UAT, and Production environments.

Bug Reporting & Jira Management

    Document clear, detailed, and reproducible bug reports in Jira.
    Attach screenshots, videos, logs, and Figma design links for better issue tracking.
    Follow up on stagnating tickets and link related issues for better traceability.
    Provide meaningful and structured comments in Jira to facilitate collaboration.

Frontend & Backend Testing

    Investigate frontend issues using Chrome DevTools (console, network tab, Redux DevTools, WebSocket monitoring).
    Test backend APIs and WebSockets using Swagger, Postman.
    Validate data in PostgreSQL using a database client (DBeaver).
    Analyze logs in Kibana and monitor Kafka topics via RedPanda.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

    Contribute to the Playwright automation framework for E2E and API testing.
    Collaborate with the QA Lead and developers to enhance test automation coverage.
    Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to improve Agile testing practices.
    Support team members through pairing, test case reviews, and sharing testing approaches to raise overall team quality.

Requirements

    5+ years of experience in software testing, ideally in web-based applications.
    Strong knowledge of test case design, execution, and defect reporting.
    Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or Swagger.
    Familiarity with browser debugging tools (Chrome DevTools, Redux DevTools).
    Exposure to Kafka, WebSockets, or real-time messaging in testing.
    Basic SQL knowledge for database validation.
    Strong understanding of Agile development and sprint-based testing.
    Clear and structured Jira documentation for bug reporting and follow-ups.
    Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for test automation.
    Knowledge of performance testing tools (Lighthouse, Artillery).

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Software and System Testing (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Your Role

As an Engineering Manager within our Testing department, you will be the driving force behind the quality and reliability of our innovative software for Electronic Control Units (ECUs) in the energy storage and electric car sectors. You will lead and mentor a dedicated team of test engineers, taking ultimate responsibility for our overall product quality, test strategy, and process compliance as well as the strategic planning, hiring, and team building of your team. Your strong leadership will be instrumental in building a world-class testing organization and ensuring our products meet the highest standards of safety and excellence, making a significant impact on the future of electric energy storage technology.

As part of your role, you will:

Lead, Empower, and Develop Your Team

  • Take full personnel responsibility for your team, including hiring, onboarding, professional development, and compensation planning.

  • Act as the primary "Go-To" person and mentor, supporting team members to achieve their goals and grow personally and professionally.

  • Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, facilitating exchange and knowledge sharing.

  • Monitor team workload and health, manage headcount planning, and structure teams for maximum effectiveness and well-being.

    Own Product Quality and Test Delivery

  • Hold the overall delivery responsibility for the testing processes of the product groups under your supervision.

  • Enable and empower the team to constantly innovate and enhance our test automation frameworks and infrastructure.

  • Make sure the test strategy and efforts are aligned with the product roadmap and customer needs.

    Drive Process Excellence and Compliance:

  • Ensure team compliance with critical automotive processes and norms such as ISO 26262, ISO 21434, and ASPICE.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for any process, quality, or technical concerns from the team.

  • Act as a direct interface for Product and Project Management, Systems and Software Development leadership, and HR to align on strategies and ensure seamless collaboration.

Your Profile

Educational Foundation: Successfully completed university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable engineering field.

Professional Experience:

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, validation, or testing, preferably in an automotive embedded systems environment.

  • More than 3 years of experience in a technical leadership, test architecture, or management role, with a proven track record of leading testing efforts for complex products.

  • Demonstrable experience with test automation strategies, tools, and frameworks.

    Domain and Standards Expertise:

  • Deep understanding of quality and safety-critical standards, ideally with hands-on experience applying ISO 26262 and ASPICE in a testing context.

  • Experience in the field of high-voltage (HV) batteries, ECUs, or battery management systems is a significant plus.

  • Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434) is highly desirable.

    Leadership Qualities:

  • Eager to assume comprehensive responsibility for a testing team while embracing ownership of product quality.

  • A creative, curious, and enthusiastic mindset for building robust and reliable electronics solutions for electric vehicles.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a preference for working collaboratively in cross-functional teams (English required; German favorable).

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

jobs.title: GTM DACH
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to your Account Executive where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across German-speaking healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across DACH. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, MVZs and hospital groups worth going after and work them in German.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the German-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in German healthcare (regulation, the practice groups, the insurers, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What we're looking for

  • Native or fluent German, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, you respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how German healthcare buys (who decides in a Praxis, an MVZ or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first month.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

 

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Compensation: €55K – €70K • + OTE

jobs.title: Compliance Automation Analyst
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that.

The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls.

  • Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review.

  • Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding.

What Ramping Up Looks Like:

You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end.

Why This Role:

  • You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist.

  • You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code.

  • We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day.

  • Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent).

  • 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus.

  • Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so.

  • Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think.

  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives.

  • Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it.

Nice to Have:

  • Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript).

  • Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar).

  • Scripting/light coding and API integration experience.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar.

  • AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure.

  • Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

Was du tun wirst

jobs.title: Quantitative Investment Analyst (d/m/w) - German speaking
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Quantitative Investment Analyst (d/m/w) bist du Teil unseres Investmentteams und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Steuerung unserer Anlagestrategien über Public und Private Markets hinweg mit. Die Position ist ab November 2026 zu besetzen.

Was machst du konkret?

  • Daten: Du verantwortest alle strategiebezogenen Daten sowie deren Pflege in unseren Systemen. Dazu gehört insbesondere der Aufbau einer robusten technischen Infrastruktur zur Aggregation, Überwachung und Darstellung von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, darunter Bloomberg, Morningstar und unser Data Warehouse.

  • Weiterentwicklung der Code Base: Du entwickelst und verbesserst unsere Code Base. Dazu gehören unter anderem Python-basierte Tools für Portfoliosimulationen, Backtesting und Fondsauswahl.

  • Asset-Allocation-Modelle: Du unterstützt die quantitative Research-Arbeit hinter unseren Asset-Allocation-Modellen, indem du eigenständig Modellerweiterungen backtestest, neue Signale evaluierst und Analysen für unsere Investmententscheidungen vorbereitest.

  • Kapitalmarktanalysen: Du führst eigenständig quantitative Kapitalmarktanalysen durch und unterstützt damit unsere Analyst sowie unsere Client Advisors.

Das bringst du mit

  • Hintergrund: Du hast einen Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Informatik, Physik oder einem verwandten Fachbereich und eine starke Affinität zu Daten. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung in den Bereichen Kapitalmärkte, statistische Modellierung oder Datenanalyse gesammelt.

  • Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen: Du verfügst über sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest äußerst sorgfältig und detailorientiert und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Python und SQL und hast Erfahrung mit Google Cloud Services. Idealerweise hast du außerdem bereits mit investmentbezogenen Datenanbietern wie Bloomberg oder Morningstar gearbeitet. Darüber hinaus bringst du ein solides Verständnis der Kapitalmärkte mit.

  • Mindset: Dein ausgeprägter Blick fürs Detail geht Hand in Hand mit einer sorgfältigen und gewissenhaften Arbeitsweise. Ineffektive und ineffiziente Prozesse stören dich, und du gehst proaktiv an Verbesserungen heran. Du fühlst dich in einem anspruchsvollen, aber informellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl und überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

     

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall.

  • Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Case Study Bearbeitung: Du erhältst einen Case zur Bearbeitung, um deine technischen Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Zum Abschluss lernst du das Investmentteam in unserem Büro in Berlin kennen und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit im Team und bei LIQID.

     

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

 

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Regulatory Counsel - Malta
jobs.description:
At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about regulation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Regulatory Counsel. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Regulatory Counsel is a mid-level role within the Regulatory function, responsible for providing independent regulatory advice and analysis to the business across multiple gambling jurisdictions.

The Regulatory Counsel takes ownership of a defined portfolio of regulatory matters, providing clear and practical advice on the application of gambling laws, licence conditions, and regulatory requirements.

The role involves independent management of licensing and regulatory submissions, proactive identification of regulatory risks, and substantive input into the development of policies, frameworks, and business initiatives. The Regulatory Counsel will develop relationships with internal stakeholders and regulators, contributing meaningfully to the delivery of the team’s objectives.

Accountabilities:

Regulatory Advisory & Interpretation

    Monitor, analyse and interpret regulatory developments across multiple gambling jurisdictions, assessing their impact on the business.
    Provide clear, practical, and independent regulatory advice to internal stakeholders across product, marketing, payments, operations, and technology.
    Conduct substantive legal research and regulatory analysis on applicable laws, licence conditions, and regulatory frameworks.
    Manage regulatory queries from the business, providing timely and well-reasoned responses with limited supervision.
    Provide regulatory input on customer-facing terms and conditions, complaints, and related matters.
    Identify and escalate novel, complex, or high-risk regulatory issues to the Senior Regulatory Counsel as appropriate.

Regulatory Strategy & Business Enablement

    Lead regulatory impact assessments in connection with new products, features, market entries, and strategic initiatives.
    Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory risks, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
    Drive cross-functional engagement to support the embedding of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Provide substantive regulatory guidance on AML/CFT, sanctions, responsible gambling, data protection, and other key regulatory areas.
    Support the Senior Regulatory Counsel in providing regulatory input into the business’s strategic planning and commercial activities.

Licensing & Regulatory Operations

    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Oversee and ensure compliance with regulatory reporting obligations, including timely and accurate submissions to licensing authorities.
    Maintain and develop regulatory registers, licences, approvals, and associated documentation.
    Manage and develop relationships with regulators and competent authorities, escalating significant regulatory interactions to the Senior Regulatory Counsel.
    Prepare and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, inspections, enforcement actions, and information requests.

Regulatory Framework & Policy Development

    Assist in the development and maintenance of assigned regulatory policies, standards, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with applicable laws and licence conditions.
    Provide substantive regulatory input into AML, responsible gambling, consumer protection, and other regulatory policy areas.
    Develop and deliver regulatory training and awareness materials to Compliance and operational teams.
    Identify gaps in existing policies and frameworks and propose improvements proactively.

Governance, Assurance & Collaboration

    Provide meaningful regulatory input into compliance monitoring activities, internal reviews, and audit processes.
    Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and operational teams to ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Lead or contribute to regulatory workstreams within internal projects, change program, and cross-functional initiatives.
    Support junior members of the Regulatory team, providing guidance and reviewing their work where required.

Documentation & General

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, records, and internal registers.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory function’s processes and ways of working.
    Perform other duties reasonably aligned with the role.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    3–4 years post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, ideally within iGaming, fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Exposure to AML/CFT, responsible gambling, and consumer protection regulatory requirements is required.
    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language (Danish, Finnish, or Swedish) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Confident and credible in providing independent regulatory advice, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
    Commercially aware and solution-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to regulatory challenges.
    Proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to developing deep expertise in international gambling regulation.
    Collaborative and effective in building relationships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

jobs.description:
INNESÄLJARE B2B – SOLNA

Vill du lära dig att sälja – och få betalt för resultat?

Brand & Utrymningskontroll växer och bygger nu upp en helt ny säljavdelning på vårt kontor i Solna.

Vi söker innesäljare som vill göra affärer.

Du kommer att arbeta med försäljning av brandskydd, systematiskt brandskyddsarbete (SBA), utbildningar och andra säkerhetslösningar till svenska företag och organisationer.

Det är produkter och tjänster som företag behöver – och som ytterst handlar om att skydda människor, verksamheter och egendom.

Vad gör du som innesäljare?

Din huvudsakliga uppgift är enkel:

Du kontaktar företag, identifierar behov och gör affärer.

Du arbetar framför allt via telefon och digitala kanaler och kommer bland annat att:

    kontakta nya och befintliga företagskunder,
    presentera våra produkter och tjänster,
    sälja våra digitala SBA-tjänster,
    följa upp offerter och tidigare kundkontakter,
    utveckla befintliga kunder,
    dokumentera och följa dina affärer i CRM,
    arbeta mot tydliga individuella mål och teammål.

Ingen säljerfarenhet? Det kan fungera ändå.

Vi kan lära dig våra produkter, våra system och hur vi arbetar med försäljning.

Det vi däremot inte kan lära ut lika enkelt är energi, arbetsvilja och viljan att utvecklas.

Därför är din inställning viktigare för oss än ett perfekt CV.

Vi tror att du:

    tycker om att prata med människor,
    är bekväm med telefonen som arbetsverktyg,
    gillar att göra affärer,
    triggas av tydliga mål,
    kan hantera ett nej och gå vidare,
    tar ansvar för dina resultat,
    vill utvecklas och tjäna mer när du blir bättre.

Tidigare erfarenhet av telefonförsäljning eller B2B-försäljning är naturligtvis meriterande.

Vi utbildar – du gör jobbet

Du får en strukturerad introduktion, produktutbildning, säljutbildning och löpande coaching.

Vi förväntar oss inte att du är färdig säljare första dagen.

Vi förväntar oss däremot att du vill bli riktigt bra.

Vi erbjuder

Fast grundlön + provision + bonus.

Dessutom får du utbildning och kontinuerlig coaching, tydliga mål, möjlighet att påverka din egen lön genom resultat och goda möjligheter att utvecklas vidare till exempelvis senior säljare, teamledare eller säljledare.

Vi börjar med ett mindre team men bygger för betydligt mer.

De personer som kommer in tidigt, levererar resultat och tar ansvar får därför möjlighet att växa tillsammans med organisationen.

Vi bygger en säljavdelning – inte bara tillsätter en tjänst

Målet är ett team med stark sammanhållning, tydliga förväntningar och människor som tycker om att vinna tillsammans.

Vill du vara med från början?

Omfattning: Heltid

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

jobs.description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Swedish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries.     Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels

    English – minimum B2 level

    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems

    Voice and non-voice customer support

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

jobs.title: Säljare Östersund
jobs.description:
Riddermark Bil är Sveriges största och snabbast växande marknadsplats för begagnade bilar. Idag består bolaget av ca 600 medarbetare i Sverige. Här är gemenskap, en familjär atmosfär och möjligheten till personlig utveckling viktiga delar trots bolagets storlek. Nu utökar vi vårt säljteam ytterligare och söker därför drivna lagspelare till vår butik i Östersund.

Om dig
Vi söker personer med specifika attityder och egenskaper, samt med en tidigare framgångsrik bakgrund inom försäljning. Gillar du förändring och triggas av utmaningar? Är du ständigt nyfiken och beredd att göra det lilla extra? Älskar du kundkontakt och brinner för den magi som uppstår vid en god försäljning? Då kan du vara rätt medarbetare för oss – och vi arbetsplatsen för dig. Vi gillar mångfald och ser gärna att fler tjejer söker våra tjänster.

Att sälja hos oss
Är enkelt. Har du ett högt engagemang, lyhördhet, ett starkt intresse och mod?
Bilförsäljning hos oss är modernt och kundfokuserat och affärerna görs lika enkelt och snabbt som noggrant och personligt. I rollen som bilförsäljare på Riddermark Bil arbetar du med bilaffärens alla steg, från första kundkontakt och provkörning till leverans och eftervård. Riddermark Bil har Sveriges största utbud av begagnade bilar. Därför blir förmågan att kunna göra en relevant behovsanalys och snabbt skapa en relation med kunden avgörande. Som säljare hos oss jobbar du i team om 5–8 personer med en gruppchef som har till uppgift att leda gruppen mot tydliga gemensamma mål.


Urval sker löpande och vi behöver din ansökan så snart som möjligt.





Vi är idag ca 600 anställda fördelade på 14 butiker, ett logistikcenter och ett huvudkontor. Trots vår storlek beskrivs vi ofta som ett mindre familjebolag, här får du vara med och påverka och hjälpa till att hela tiden driva vår tillväxt i rätt riktning med fler och nöjdare kunder. Riddermark bil är ett utav Sveriges mest expansiva företag, den självklara marknadsplatsen för begagnade bilar. Stolt leder vi utvecklingen inom försäljning och avyttring av begagnade bilar genom lagarbete, nytänkande och lyhördhet. Med flera stora anläggningar i Sverige hjälper vi privatpersoner och företag med sina bilaffärer. Vi bygger och utvecklar egna IT-system om vi helt enkelt anser att det saknas tillräckligt bra sådana, och varje dag strävar vi efter att göra allting lite bättre. Våra medarbetare rekryteras främst för sina värderingar.

Då kan du vara rätt medarbetare för oss – och vi arbetsplatsen för dig. Vi gillar mångfald och ser gärna att fler tjejer söker våra tjänster.

Att sälja hos oss
Är enkelt. Har du ett högt engagemang, lyhördhet, ett starkt intresse och mod?
Bilförsäljning hos oss är modernt och kundfokuserat och affärerna görs lika enkelt och snabbt som noggrant och personligt. I rollen som bilförsäljare på Riddermark Bil arbetar du med bilaffärens alla steg, från första kundkontakt och provkörning till leverans och eftervård. Riddermark Bil har Sveriges största utbud av begagnade bilar. Därför blir förmågan att kunna göra en relevant behovsanalys och snabbt skapa en relation med kunden avgörande. Som säljare hos oss jobbar du i team om 5–8 personer med en gruppchef som har till uppgift att leda gruppen mot tydliga gemensamma mål.


Urval sker löpande och vi behöver din ansökan så snart som möjligt.





Vi är idag ca 600 anställda fördelade på 14 butiker, ett logistikcenter och ett huvudkontor. Trots vår storlek beskrivs vi ofta som ett mindre familjebolag, här får du vara med och påverka och hjälpa till att hela tiden driva vår tillväxt i rätt riktning med fler och nöjdare kunder. Riddermark bil är ett utav Sveriges mest expansiva företag, den självklara marknadsplatsen för begagnade bilar. Stolt leder vi utvecklingen inom försäljning och avyttring av begagnade bilar genom lagarbete, nytänkande och lyhördhet. Med flera stora anläggningar i Sverige hjälper vi privatpersoner och företag med sina bilaffärer. Vi bygger och utvecklar egna IT-system om vi helt enkelt anser att det saknas tillräckligt bra sådana, och varje dag strävar vi efter att göra allting lite bättre. Våra medarbetare rekryteras främst för sina värderingar.

jobs.title: Embedded developer - C++, Python, Linux
jobs.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Senior Embedded C++ Developer – Robotics

📍 Location: Huskvarna, Sweden

🏢 Work model: On-site (0% remote)

📅 Assignment period: 11 November 2026 – 31 October 2027

🎯 Seniority: Senior

⏰ Application deadline: 11 October 2026

Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role

Availability: Immediately/on a short notice

We are looking for a Senior Embedded C++ Developer to join an exciting robotics development initiative focused on building and improving next-generation autonomous robotic products.

You will work on software that controls robot behavior, decision-making, navigation, and planning — ranging from low-level embedded functionality to advanced algorithms supporting autonomous operation.

The role involves working primarily with C/C++ and Python in a Linux-based environment, collaborating closely with engineers across software, hardware, sensors, and robotics.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced embedded developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to see their software operate in real-world robotic systems.

Key Responsibilities

    Develop and improve embedded software for advanced robotic products.

    Design, implement, test, and verify new technical solutions.
    Work with C/C++ and Python in a Linux-based development environment.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams involving software, hardware, sensors, and robotics.
    Contribute to the development of future robotic platforms.

    Potentially take a technical leadership role within cross-functional development teams.
    Continuously improve development processes, software quality, and engineering practices.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone with strong technical skills, curiosity, and a genuine passion for embedded software and robotics.

You should be:

    Experienced in embedded software development.
    Highly proficient in C/C++.
    Comfortable working with Python.
    Experienced with Linux-based development environments.
    Comfortable working across software and hardware boundaries.
    Analytical and confident in solving complex technical problems.
    Collaborative, communicative, and comfortable working in cross-functional teams.
    Interested in exploring how AI and modern development tools can improve engineering efficiency and quality.

Required Skills

✅ Strong experience in embedded software development

✅ Python experience

Nice to Have / Meritorious

Experience with any of the following will be considered a strong advantage:

    Real-time systems

    Sensors and sensor integration
    Motors / motor control
    Robotics
    Autonomous systems
    Navigation and planning algorithms
    Hardware-software integration
    Hands-on testing and troubleshooting

Swedish language skills are not mandatory, but Swedish proficiency is considered an advantage.

Why This Opportunity?

🤖 Work with advanced robotic technology

💻 Develop software that interacts with real-world hardware

🧠 Work with autonomy, navigation, sensors, and intelligent systems

🔧 Combine software engineering with hands-on robotics

🚀 Contribute to the development of future robotic platforms

Interested?

If you are a Senior Embedded C/C++ Developer looking for your next opportunity in robotics, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Vollzeit) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
