jobs.title: Office Manager til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, har et skarpt digitalt overblik, og trives du i en alsidig hverdag med både it-projekter og tæt berøring med organisationens drift? Så er du måske vores nye administrative Office Manager på Holstedgaard.

Holstedgaard er en selvejende institution, et psykiatrisk botilbud med plads til 69 beboer fordelt på flere afdelinger i alderen 18-100 år. Vi har gennem mange år oplevet en positiv vækst og vokset i volumen. I takt med denne udvikling, møder vi også øgede krav til dokumentation, opfølgning og administrative opgaver. For at imødekomme disse krav og løfte vores faglighed endnu mere, opretter vi nu en helt ny administrativ stilling.

På Holstedgaard søger vi en engageret og selvstændig administrativ medarbejder, der kan samle trådene i vores dagligdag. Du vil få en central rolle i organisationen, hvor du sikrer, at vores administrative processer kører smidigt, og at vores digitale systemer altid er opdaterede. Da vi står over for flere spændende it-projekter og administrative udvidelser, leder vi efter en profil, der har stærke it-kompetencer og mod på at kaste sig over nye systemer.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Systemadministrator på Planner4You: Du bliver vores interne superbruger og administrator på vores dokumentationssystem, hvor du sikrer struktur og datadisciplin.

  • Hjemmeside og ugentligt nyhedsbrev: Du får ansvaret for at opdatere vores hjemmeside, som står over for en større ændring (samt efterfølgende vedligeholdelse). Derudover står du for at udarbejde og udsende vores ugentlige nyhedsbrev i samarbejde med vores socialrådgiver.

  • Implementering af MyMedCards: Du bliver en drivende kraft i implementeringen og udrulningen af MyMedCards i organisationen.

  • Beboerøkonomi: Du er med til at håndtere de administrative opgaver omkring den interne bank, vi har for vores beboere.

  • Tilbudsportalen: Du vil blive oplært i og være med til at varetage dokumentationen i Tilbudsportalen.

  • Rekruttering og HR-support: Du er med til at udarbejder og publicerer vores jobopslag på diverse jobportaler, når vi søger nye kolleger.

  • Kursusstyring og planlægning: Du er med i at bevarer det forkromede overblik over virksomhedens årshjul. Du koordinerer interne og eksterne undervisningsdage, samt møder og er med i at booke eksterne underviser ind.

  • Andre administrative opgaver: Du er med til at udfylder boligkontrakter, lønsedler og andre administrative ad hoc-opgaver.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med administrative opgaver og trives i en alsidig blæksprutterolle.

  • Er digitalt stærk: Du behøver ikke at kende vores systemer (som Planner4You, MyMedCards eller Tilbudsportalen) på forhånd, men du skal have solide it-kompetencer, der gør dig i stand til at understøtte implementeringen af nye systemer.

  • Har lyst, vilje og interesse for hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye digitale emner og administrative arbejdsgange.

  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og formår at bevare overblikket – selv når der er mange bolde i luften.

  • Møder beboere og kolleger med tillid og et smil, også når du er med til at administrerer den interne bank.

  • Kommunikerer fejlfrit på dansk i både skrift og tale.

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

jobs.title: Saksbehandlar
jobs.description:
Vil du arbeide som saksbehandlar i ein jordskifterett? Hjå oss får du ansvar for eigne oppgåver, samtidig som du arbeider tett saman med fagleg sterke kollegaer med eit stort engasjement for domstolane. 

Landet er delt inn i 19 jordskifterettar med ca. 230 tilsette. Jordskifteretten er ein særdomstol som i hovudsak arbeider med omforming av eigedommar, organiserer felles bruk av eigedommar, klargjer rettsforhold og grenser til fast eigedom, og ei rekke skjønn. Du kan lese meir på www.domstol.no/jordskifterettene. 

Som saksbehandlar får du arbeide med eit breitt spekter av oppgåver, som å førebu, leggje til rette for og etterbehandle saker i nært samarbeid med jordskiftedommarane. I løpet av arbeidsdagen har du kontakt med partar, advokatar og andre profesjonelle aktørar. Di rolle er viktig og du bidreg til at sakene blir gjennomførte på ein effektiv og profesjonell måte til beste for brukarane av jordskifteretten. 

Her er ingen dag lik, og din innsats er heilt nødvendig for at vi kan gjennomføre rettsakene. Sjå korleis tilsette i jordskifteretten presenterer stillingane sine: Jobb i jordskifterettene | Norges domstoler

Møre og Romsdal jordskifterett har rettsstadar i Ørsta, Molde og Surnadal og denne stillinga er knytt til rettsstaden i Ørsta. Domstolen blir leia av ein domstolleiar og har i dag seks jordskiftedommarar, ein dommarfullmektigar, åtte tekniske utgreiarar og tre saksbehandlarar. Du vil med andre ord få eit tverrfagleg arbeidsmiljø med svært kompetente kollegaer som alle deler eit engasjement for samfunnsoppdraget vårt. Møre og Romsdal jordskifterett dekkjer alle kommunane i Møre og Romsdal samt Rindal kommune i Trøndelag.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Saksbehandlarane har ein kvardag med varierte oppgåver, som i perioder kan vere hektisk og krevjande.

Arbeidsoppgåvene er:

  • Arbeid knytt til førebuing, gjennomføring og etterarbeid av rettsaker - i samarbeid med dommar og ingeniør
  • Kommunikasjon med eksterne aktørar og andre brukarar - mellom anna bidra til aktiv saksstyring og sakshandsaming

Saksbehandlarane er domstolen sin førstelinje og du vil derfor få ein del kontakt med publikum. Vi jobbar med stadig forbetring av rutinar og bruk av ny teknologi. Du vil vere ein viktig bidragsytar inn i dette arbeidet. I tillegg har i dag saksbehandlar i Ørsta ansvaret for innregistrering av fysisk post som kjem til domstolen.

Arbeidsoppgåvene vil kunne endre seg etter domstolen sine behov.

Kvalifikasjoner

For å bli saksbehandlar bør du ha følgjande kompetanse:

  • utdanning på bachelornivå, fortrinnsvis med fag innan administrasjon og samfunnsfag, juss eller IT, eller ha fagbrev i kontor- og administrasjonsfag
  • relevant arbeidserfaring frå saksbehandling
  • gode digitale ferdigheiter, interesse for ny teknologi og evne til å sjå molegheiter i digitale prosessar og verktøy
  • god skriftleg og munnleg fremstillingsevne på norsk
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du arbeider sjølvstendig og strukturert.
  • Du yter service og opptrer på ein objektiv og tillitsvekkjande måte overfor partane i sakene.
  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner og bidreg til eit godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Du kan delta i dialog med partar, private og offentlege instansar på ein god og forståeleg måte.
  • Du er kvalitetsmedviten, nøyaktig og løysningsorientert.
  • Du taklar ein travel kvardag med mange ulike oppgåver og mange baller i lufta.
Vi tilbyr

I tillegg til ein jobb som er viktig for både enkeltpersonar og samfunnet får du: 

  • molegheita til å utvikle både domstolen og deg sjølv
  • eit godt tverrfagleg miljø
  • varierte og utfordrande arbeidsoppgåver
  • ulike tilbod om relevant kompetanseheving
  • fleksibel arbeidskvardag med fleksitid, og trening i arbeidstida
  • gode pensjons-, forsikrings- og låneordningar i Statens pensjonskasse

Stillinga blir lønt som førstekonsulent (kode 1408)/rådgivar (kode 1434) etter Hovedtariffavtalen, avhengig av din kompetanse. 

KontaktinformasjonAsbjørn Rogne, Jordskifterettsleiar, +(47) 976 94 840, asbjorn.rogne@domstol.no
ArbeidsstedStrandgata 5
6150 Ørsta

Fast

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Domstolane er den tredje statsmakta. Noreg har 55 domstolar med om lag 2000 medarbeidarar. Som samfunnet sin viktigaste konfliktløysar er domstolane avhengige av tillit. Det inneber at verksemda må innfri samfunnet sine krav og forventningar.

Domstolane er avgjerande for at vi har eit trygt og godt samfunn bygd på tillit. Alle skal ha tillit til og respektere avgjerdene våre, uavhengig av utfallet. Hos oss kan kvar og ein få avgjort saka si, setje strek og kome seg vidare.

Med rolla vår følgjer eit stort ansvar. Avgjerdene våre er uavhengige og upåverka av styresmakter eller press frå andre miljø. Domstolane arbeider med komplekse og varierte juridiske problemstillingar.

Personopplysningar i søknad og CV til stillinga blir behandla i samsvar med lov om behandling av personopplysningar. Du kan lese meir om personvern på www.domstol.no.

Vi utarbeider offentleg søkjarliste og viser til offentleglova § 25 andre ledd når det gjeld moglegheita for å bli unnateken frå denne.

Mangfald i Noregs domstolar

Det er viktig at dei tilsette i Noregs domstolar representerer eit godt mangfald med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring. Vi har i dag eit rikt og fleirkulturelt samfunn. Noregs domstolar ønskjer derfor å rekruttere fleire medarbeidarar som har fleirkulturell bakgrunn og erfaring. Dette vil gi oss viktig kunnskap i utføringa av samfunnsoppdraget. Mangfald er ein styrke, og vi vil leggje til rette for tilsette med ulike behov. Les meir om moglegheita for positiv særbehandling på arbeidsgiver.dfo.no.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-modal microscopy and tomography of virus-infected organoids
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in the development of multimodal microscopy for studying viral infection in organoids, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

Investigating viral interactions within host cells at the single-particle level poses significant challenges due to the resolution limitations of conventional microscopy, particularly in complex organoid tissue sections and lack of multi-modality approach. To overcome these obstacles, it is necessary to develop and apply multi-modal optical microscopy methods, such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy and label-free optical diffraction tomography and quantitative phase microscopy. Another important aspect of this project is to perform advance image analysis on correlative datasets to extract the underlying knowledge. The technical aspect of this project aims to integrate two cutting-edge microscopy platforms, photonic chip-based multimodal microscopy and quantitative phase microscopy (QPM)/optical diffraction tomography. These instruments will be used to study viral infections in organoid models (such as gut and brain). Post-imaging, we will conduct advanced image analysis, develop different models for correlative imaging and on label-free images. As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other DC such as DC 1, DC 6 DC 8 and DC 10.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 5) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 5 will be:

  • To develop and adapt a multi-modal optical microscopy platform with focus on two modalities, a) photonic chip-based super-resolution optical microscopy and b) optical diffraction tomography & quantitative phase microscopy.
  • To perform correlative fluorescence optical microscopy with 3D quantitative phase tomography to facilitate virtual specificity
  • To generate correlated datasets for analysis of microenvironmental changes during HIV-1 and VEEV infection. To use organoid sections, intact organoids and cells models in this study.
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted segmentation, classification and correlation
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to imaging, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Prof. Dag Kristian Dysthe. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
Doctoral Candidate 5 Vacancy — MERIT


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related field in biomedical engineering and biophysics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date,
  • Solid, hands-on experience with experimental optical instrumentation, including the development, alignment, operation and/or application of optical microscopy systems,
  • Strong background in image analysis or similar scientific data analysis using Python or MATLAB,
  • An interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group.

Desired qualifications:

  • Background in adapting or development of optical microscopy platforms such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy, diffraction tomography or quantitative phase microscopy systems,
  • Machine learning or AI-assisted analysis of microscopy or other high-dimensional imaging datasets,
  • Image reconstruction and computational microscopy, including algorithms for super-resolution microscopy, phase retrieval, quantitative phase imaging, or optical diffraction tomography,
  • Advanced image analysis, including image registration, segmentation, feature extraction, classification, and correlative/multimodal image analysis.
  • Experience in bioimaging and handling of biological samples,
  • As the target applications involve organoids and viruses, it is beneficial if the candidate have experience working with various biological specimen such as tissue sections or organoid samples,
  • Willingness to collaborate within an international research network and undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details.

Language requirements

  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8
     

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD programme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7. The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The average grade point for courses included in the master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. It is essential that the researcher can effectively communicate with the collaborators within the EU project in the field of biology,
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks,
  • Good communication and collaboration skills,
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods and multi-tasking.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours

jobs.title: Pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper pr. 01/12 - 2026
jobs.description:
Rosendalskolen søger engageret pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper pr. 01/12 - 2026 (eller hurtigst muligt)

Brænder du for både det almene SFO-liv og specialpædagogiske indsatser? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler!

Stillingen er en fastansættelse på 30–32 timer om ugen.

Om stillingen og opgaverne

Som vores nye pædagog, pædagogiske assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper får du en varieret og spændende hverdag, hvor du ugentligt er fordelt på to pædagogiske arenaer:

  • SFO: Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team med pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogstuderende. SFO’en er fysisk opdelt i to afdelinger (0.–1. klasse og 2.–3. klasse) med ca. 235 indmeldte børn. 
  • Afdeling C: Nogle af ugens arbejdsdage er placeret i vores specialafdeling, Afdeling C, hvor du bringer din pædagogiske faglighed i spil i rammer med særligt fokus på struktur, forudsigelighed og mindre børnegrupper.
Vi tilbyder:
  • En stilling på 30–32 timer om ugen.
  • En kreativ og engageret personalegruppe bestående af både pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogstuderende.
  • Et professionelt pædagogisk miljø med højt til loftet.
  • En arbejdsplads med stor grad af ansvar, medbestemmelse og engagerede kolleger.
  • Fantastiske udearealer, der giver vide rammer for pædagogiske aktiviteter.
Vi forventer, at du:
  • Er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant erfaring. 
  • Har blik for individuelle behov: Du har fokus på at skabe trygge rammer for børn med særlige eller individuelle behov (f.eks. ved hjælp af struktur, forudsigelighed og pauser i mindre grupper) – både i SFO'en og i Afdeling C.
  • Er anerkendende og skaber tryghed: Du arbejder ud fra en gensidig anerkendende tilgang til både børn, forældre og kolleger og har en naturlig evne til at skabe nærhed.
  • Du har øje for det, det enkelte barn mestrer, og formår at bygge videre herpå.
  • Kan omsætte idéer til handling: Du kan inspirere til læring i SFO-tiden og har mod på at sætte aktiviteter i gang.

Rosendalskolen ligger i Hobro kun 5 minutter fra motorvejen, og byen har gode togforbindelser både nord og syd på. Skolen har 2 spor og cirka 700 positive og interesserede elever. Personalemæssigt er vi omkring 100 medarbejdere på skolen – lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, teknisk service, administration, flexjobbere og ledelse. Vi er organiseret i afdelings- og årgangsteams, og der er en udvidet grad af selvstyring i afdelingerne. Hver afdeling har egen afdelingsleder.

Skolen har i de senere år fokuseret på udviklingen af de faglige fællesskaber. Vi har udviklet vores pædagogiske værktøjskasse i anvendelsen af bl.a. vejledere og klassekonferencer for at understøtte den enkelte elevs læring og udvikling. Yderligere har vi fokus på udvikling af professionelle læringsfællesskaber, hvor en konkret undersøgelse af egen og andres praksis skal være basis for videreudviklingen af skolen.

Skolen er i dagligdagen kendetegnet ved rigtig gode faglige og trivselsmæssige resultater, dette bl.a. via et godt og inspirerende samarbejde mellem personalet, forældrene og eleverne.

Yderligere oplysninger:

For yderligere oplysninger eller aftale om besøg, er du velkommen til at kontakte SFO-leder Simon Bach Pedersen på tlf.nr.: 20323724


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, hvor lønnen aftales med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.  

Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at disse kan godkendes.  

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
Så send din ansøgning til Mariagerfjord Kommune via vores hjemmeside.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 01/12 2026

Der er ansøgningsfrist til stillingen 25/10 2026

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 44

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen. 

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.   

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

jobs.title: PhD position in epigenetics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a 3-year position as PhD student in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst others the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. The PhD project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance. 

Yvonne Böttcher’ s research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will also focus, amongst others, on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss. 

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with excellent clinical environments in Norway and abroad. The successful applicant will work amongst others on human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms involved in long-term weight trajectories. The PhD candidate will be involved in identifying novel epigenetic biomarkers of weight regain using primary adipose tissue derived from ongoing clinical collaborations and advanced molecular biology techniques such as single-cell, next generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies.

The position will require large degree of interdisciplinary collaboration within CORA.


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Work on scientific projects related epigenetic mechanísms and weight regulation
  • Closely collaborate within the research group, the center and clinical environments important for the center
  • Contribute to th reserarch environments of the research group and the whole center
  • Contribute to and exchange knowledge in the K. G. Jebsen Academy for Young Scientists
  • Be updated on the latest literature in the field
  • Contribute actively to seminars, discussion, presentations, conferences etc.

Qualifications and competence 

Qualification requirements:

  • Master of Science in molecular biology, molecular medicine, genetics, biomedicine or similar with an average grade of B or better at the Master level
  • Hands-on experience in general molecular biology laboratory techniques, such as: RNA/ DNA isolation, protein extraction methods, RT-qPCR, genotyping, western blotting, Immunoprecipitation, adipocyte cell culture
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to independently design, plan, and execute experiments
  • To be admitted to the PhD programmes at the University of Oslo, an applicant must have a five year master's degree or equivalent studies that have been recognised by the faculty as forming a sufficient basis for admission. 
    For more information see: Why choose this PhD programme? - Faculty of Medicine
  • To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to a doctoral program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Normally, one must apply for admission to a Ph.D. program within 3 months after the start of the research project leading to the Ph.D. degree. For more information, please see our website: https://www.med.uio.no/english/research/phd/index.html   
     

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Experience in obesity research and/or epigenetics
  • Hands-on experience with methods within epigenetics such as ChIP, Cut & Tag, bisulphite sequencing, ATAC seq, RNA seq or similar
  • Experience with next generation sequencing data analysis and work with sensitive data
  • Basic programming skills (R/Python/Unix)
  • Competence in statistics (R/SPSS/Stata)

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent 
  • Structured and well organized
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive, enthusiastic about science

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer / We can offer you / Why should you choose us?
  • A stimulating work environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-disciplinary collaborations and career development.
  • Excellent laboratory facilities at EpiGen.
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter

  •  Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Erfaren køkkenvikar søges til børneinstitution i Brøndby
jobs.description:
På vegne af en børneinstitution i Brøndby søger FIRMAVIKAR en stabil og erfaren køkkenvikar til et længerevarende vikariat med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Der er tale om et vikariat i forbindelse med sygdom, og vi søger derfor en person, som kan tage ansvar for den daglige drift af køkkenet og skabe en stabil hverdag gennem hele perioden.

Om jobbet

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Tilberedning af dagens måltider

  • Planlægning af mad og menu

  • Håndtering af særlige kosthensyn og allergener

  • Egenkontrol og sikring af gældende hygiejneregler

  • Opvask og oprydning

  • Rengøring og almindelig drift af køkkenet

  • Sikre struktur og overblik i den daglige køkkendrift

I den første periode vil vareindkøb ikke være en del af opgaverne.

Vi søger som udgangspunkt den samme person til hele perioden, så det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde stabilt og kontinuerligt.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med køkkenarbejde og madlavning

  • Gerne har erfaring fra institution, kantine eller storkøkken

  • Har erfaring med kosthensyn i forbindelse med allergener samt egenkontrol

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Er stabil, struktureret og møder til tiden

  • Har fokus på hygiejne og orden

  • Trives med at arbejde i et køkken i en børneinstitution

Arbejdssted
Brøndby

Arbejdstid
Mandag kl. 08.00–15.00
Tirsdag til fredag kl. 08.00–14.00

I alt ca. 31 timer om ugen.

Periode
Som udgangspunkt minimum 1 måned med mulighed for forlængelse.

Opstart
Hurtigst muligt.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, hører vi meget gerne fra dig hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and AF micro-spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and autofluorescence micro-spectroscopy, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

This doctoral project will develop and apply advanced label-free optical spectroscopy approaches to investigate molecular and metabolic changes in organoid models of viral infection. The project will combine Raman micro-spectroscopy and UV–visible autofluorescence (AF) spectroscopy, providing complementary information on the biochemical and metabolic state of biological samples without requiring external fluorescent labels. Raman micro-spectroscopy, primarily using 785 nm excitation, will obtain molecular fingerprints associated with lipids, proteins, nucleic acids and metabolites. Complementary UV–visible autofluorescence spectroscopy in the 350–500 nm spectral range will probe endogenous fluorescence signatures associated with cellular metabolism and biochemical composition. The project will investigate both free-space spectroscopy and waveguide-enhanced spectroscopic approaches, including waveguide-enhanced Raman and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy, with the aim of improving sensitivity to subtle molecular changes.

Photonic waveguides provide strong and spatially extended light–matter interaction through the evanescent optical field, offering opportunities to enhance Raman signals and AF-signals and improve sensitivity compared with conventional free-space measurements. Particular emphasis will be placed on identifying spectral signatures associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming that may precede observable structural changes. AI-assisted spectral analysis will be explored to analyse the high-dimensional Raman and autofluorescence datasets. Machine-learning approaches will be used to identify spectral features and molecular signatures associated with infection, distinguish different biological states, and correlate spectroscopic changes with disease progression. The project will use organoid models of HIV-1 and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) infection.

As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other doctoral candidates (DC): DC 5, DC 9-10 and DC 12.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 6) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 6 will be:

  • To develop and adapt Raman and autofluorescence spectroscopy platform,
  • To explore both free space and optical waveguide-enhanced Raman spectroscopy and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy,
  • To apply these spectroscopy tools for organoid sections, analytes and virus,
  • To generate spectral signatures (Raman and AF- library) associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming during HIV-1 and VEEV infection,
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted spectral analysis for high-dimensional Raman and AF- signals,
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to spectroscopy, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Associated Professor Elisabeth Wetzer. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
Doctoral Candidate 6 Vacancy — MERIT


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related fields such as biophysics and biomedical technologies. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date
  • A strong background in optics, photonics, spectroscopy, or related experimental techniques. Hands-on experimental experience with the development, operation or application of optical spectroscopic instrumentation, such as Raman spectroscopy.
  • Experience with data analysis and scientific programming, for example using Python, MATLAB or equivalent tools.
  • Familiarity with image/spectral analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python and basic AI tools
  • Willingness to undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions within the MSCA Doctoral Network and to collaborate closely with other doctoral candidates.

Desired qualifications:

  • Integrated photonics, optical waveguides, photonic chips or evanescent-field spectroscopy
  • Experience in handling of biological samples and image analysis.
  • Raman spectroscopy, Raman microscopy or other forms of vibrational spectroscopy.
  • Autofluorescence, fluorescence spectroscopy or fluorescence microscopy.
  • Spectroscopic or optical measurements of biological samples, including cells, tissues, organoids, microorganisms or viruses.
  • Multivariate spectral analysis, including PCA, clustering, classification or chemometric methods.
  • Machine learning/AI approaches for spectroscopy, imaging or other high-dimensional experimental datasets.
  • Development and automation of optical instrumentation, including instrument control, data acquisition and image/spectral processing.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details.

Language requirements

  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8
     

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD programme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7. The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The average grade point for courses included in the master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. It is essential that the researcher can effectively communicate with the collaborators within the EU project in the field of biology,
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks,
  • Good communication and collaboration skills,
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods and multi-tasking.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department of Physics covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

jobs.title: Behandlingspedagog som vill göra skillnad (Vikariat)
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.



SiS LVM-hem Östfora i Järlåsa nordväst om Uppsala tar emot män med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk, i kombination med psykisk ohälsa. Vi har särskild kompetens för medicinsk omvårdnad och har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för klienter med särskilda vårdbehov.



Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är vikariatet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning! Om du brinner för att arbeta med människor i utsatta situationer och vill vara en del av ett team där din insats gör skillnad är detta din chans.

Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter, behandlingssekreterare och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på för våra klienter. Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande!

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema och omfattas av dag, kväll och var tredje helg.

Arbetstiderna är

    07.00 - 15.30
    09.00 - 17.30
    13.00 - 21.30

Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå vår interna introduktionsutbildning som varvar teori och praktik. Den initiala introduktionsperioden omfattar två veckors dagtjänstgöring och du behöver ha möjlighet att delta i denna i sin helhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra klienter. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med klienter likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort och tillgång till bil
    God svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande för oss om du även har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete med vår målgrupp (missbruksvård ,ungdomsvård)
    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer tex arbete inom psykiatri eller LSS omsorg
    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på kriminalvården ex kriminalvårdare

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

    Tjänsten är ett heltidsvikariat på 6 månader. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
    Urval, intervjuer och tillsättning sker löpande.
    För att din ansökan skall kunna bedömas korrekt behöver du bifoga relevanta utbildningsunderlag i samband med ansökan som styrker att du uppfyller ska-kraven för aktuell tjänst.
    Tester och arbetsprover kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen.

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg

SiS som arbetsgivare erbjuder en rad förmåner såsom generöst friskvårdsbidrag, antal semesterdagar, avsättning till statlig tjänstepension mm - https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/formaner

SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande. För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning. Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming BESS
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:    

BackgroundThe increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability.

     Research Question  

The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems.







Objectives




    Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication.  
    Improve dynamic response during power dispatch.  
    Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing.  
    Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations.  
    Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by   voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs.  

     Scope Of Work  


    Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4]  
    Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12]  
    Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21]  
    Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26]  
    Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29]  

     Candidate Competencies  


    Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems  
    Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable.  
    Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit.  

     Ready for the next move?  

Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!



Roeland BisschopHead of BESS Product Developmentroeland.bisschop@volvo.com







Last application date: 2026-10-21

    

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.title: Assisterende kjøkkensjef
jobs.description:
Assisterende kjøkkensjef – Quality Hotel Sarpsborg

Quality Hotel Sarpsborg søker en engasjert og faglig sterk assisterende kjøkkensjef som ønsker å ta ansvar, gå foran som et godt eksempel og bidra aktivt til å videreutvikle kjøkkenet på vår restaurant.

Vi ser etter deg som verdsetter klassisk kokkehåndverk, trives med struktur og planlegging, og motiveres av å skape gode resultater sammen med andre. Som assisterende kjøkkensjef blir du en sentral drivkraft i den daglige kjøkkendriften, med ansvar for å opprettholde høye standarder innen kvalitet, presisjon, samarbeid og gjesteopplevelser.

Om rollen

Som assisterende kjøkkensjef er du kjøkkensjefens høyre hånd og en sentral ressurs i den daglige driften. Du kombinerer operativt kjøkkenarbeid med faglig oppfølging og ledelse av teamet. Sammen med kjøkkensjefen bidrar du til å sikre høy kvalitet, effektiv drift og matopplevelser som gjenspeiler hotellets unike omgivelser og ambisjoner.

Dine ansvarsområder

jobs.title: Customer Care Specialists Nordic
jobs.description:
Would you like to help create the best customer experience in the Nordic market?

GARDENA, part of Husqvarna Group, is looking for two Customer Care Specialists to join our Nordic Customer Care team. One position is full-time (100%) and the other is part-time (80%).

We are building the Customer Care organization of the future, and we are looking for service-minded colleagues who enjoy solving problems and making a difference for customers every day. You will work in a Nordic and international environment where collaboration, customer focus and development are at the heart of what we do.

What We Offer

At GARDENA, you will become part of Husqvarna Group, an international organization with strong brands and ambitious goals. You will join an engaged Nordic team with a strong sense of collaboration and shared responsibility.

The role offers broad contact across functions and markets, as well as the opportunity to influence and improve how we work. You will develop your knowledge of customer service, products, systems and business processes in an environment where learning and customer value go hand in hand.

About the Role

As a Customer Care Specialist, you play an important role in creating a smooth and professional customer experience across the Nordic market. You will be in daily contact with our customers, the sales organization, logistics and other internal functions, ensuring that questions, orders, deliveries and claims are handled efficiently and with high quality.

You will take ownership of customer cases, communicate clearly and proactively, and contribute to the continued development of Customer Care Nordic.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle incoming customer inquiries via phone, email and digital channels.
    Provide support related to products, orders, deliveries and claims.
    Register, administer and follow up customer orders.
    Ensure accurate customer and order data in our systems.
    Collaborate closely with colleagues in sales, logistics, planning and other support functions.

You will also contribute to improvements in processes and ways of working, and participate in projects and development initiatives within Customer Care Nordic.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who enjoys customer contact and is motivated by finding solutions. You are structured, attentive to details and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You communicate clearly, collaborate well across functions and national borders, and contribute positively to the team.

Qualifications

As the role involves daily contact with customers in several Nordic countries, language skills are essential. You must be professionally proficient in Swedish and Norwegian and preferably also in Danish.

Good English skills are a must and experience from a Nordic organization are beneficial.

We also see that you have:

    Previous experience in customer service, order administration or a similar service-oriented role.
    Strong administrative and organizational skills.
    A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to take ownership of customer cases.
    Good digital skills and confidence working in multiple systems.
    Ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.

Location

Huskvarna or Jonsered

How We Work

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Development

At GARDENA we strive to have a work environment that is inclusive and diverse, where we believe that our differences are our strengths. Our winning culture is important to us, which is why we go by the beliefs: We’re Bold, We’re Dedicated and We Care

The Application

Apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis. Please indicate in your application whether you are interested in the full-time position, the part-time position, or both.

We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For more information about the position please contact Hiring Manager Jill Hansen, Team Leader Customer Care, at Jill.Hansen@husqvarnagroup.com

For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact Talent Acquisition partner Katarina Engberg at katarina.engberg@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we will ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice.

About GARDENA

For over 50 years, GARDENA has been dedicated to helping people take better care of their gardens, yards and outdoor spaces. Driven by our own passion and experience for every aspect of garden care, we engineer the smart tools and clever solutions that allow people all around the world to create small moments of wonder in their gardens – moments of achievement, contentment, order, and joy, all year round, year after year. GARDENA is part of Husqvarna Group.

Welcome with your application and become part of our Nordic Customer Care team!

jobs.title: Begravningsrådgivare - Götmars 2026
jobs.description:
Götmars är ett familjeföretag som erbjuder tjänster kopplade till livets olika skeenden. Med familjejuridisk service och begravning är Götmars ett tryggt stöd genom hela livet. Totalt har gruppen ett 20-tal begravningsrådgivare på olika orter runt Örebro, Västmanland och Dalarna samt ett tjugotal jurister och boutredare verksamma på kontoren i Örebro och Västerås. Hos Götmars får du ett arbete med mening. Varje dag möter vi människor i en av livets mest känsliga stunder och vårt uppdrag är att skapa trygghet, omtanke och personligt stöd hela vägen.

Begravningsrådgivare till Götmars Hallstahammar/Västerås

Som begravningsrådgivare handlar ditt arbete om att bemöta människor i sorg, och arrangera begravningar efter personliga önskemål. Vi som jobbar som begravningsrådgivare känner verkligen att det arbete vi utför är meningsfullt och att vi verkligen har valt rätt yrke. Vill du bli ett med vårt sammansvetsade team där god sammanhållning och professionellt och mänskligt bemötande utgör en grund för bra resultat? Har du ett bemötande som du tror skulle passa för den verksamhet vi bedriver?

Om du är den som vi beskriver vill vi komma i kontakt med dig! Vi söker nu en ny kollega till oss med placering i Hallstahammar/Västerås.Det här är vårt erbjudande och därmed också dina kommande arbetsuppgifter:

    

Rådgivning och helhetsansvar kring ett begravningsuppdrag

    

Arrangemang av begravningar, både borgerliga och kyrkliga enligt olika trossamfund

    

Representera vid begravning, avsked och minnesstunder

    

Bistå i planering av framtida begravningar

    

Stöd åt familjer i hela planeringsprocessen

    

Kistläggning och transport av avlidna (innehåller moment av tunga lyft)

    

Kontakter med kunder och gäster kring t ex minnesgåvor och allmänna frågor

Till oss kommer personer som ska begrava en anhörig som kommit upp i åldern men också människor som har mist närstående i ett alltför tidigt skede på grund av sjukdom eller olycka. När man kommer in till oss så ser vi vikten av ett personligt bemötande och att man trots situationen ska känna en trygghet och ett lugn. Som begravningsrådgivare är vi stödet genom hela processen, vi är även med vid själva begravningen för praktiskt och personligt stöd.

Vem passar hos oss?

Vi som arbetar som begravningsrådgivare har olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Det viktiga är att du har ett bemötande och en förmåga att skapa en relation med olika människor i en speciell situation i livet. Erfarenheter av kundservice i någon form är meriterande och att du är van att jobba i en miljö där det ibland blir ett högt tempo.

Rollen kräver att du är bra på att kommunicera, skapa förtroende samtidigt som du har integritet som din trygga grund. Du kommer ha en koordinerande roll så det är viktigt med noggrannhet, att kunna hålla igång fler uppgifter parallellt och att du har en stark administrativ ådra. Att ge god service är viktigt för dig och din personlighet präglas av att alltid ge kunden det bästa.

B-körkort är ett krav liksom goda datakunskaper. Vi jobbar i vårt egenutvecklade system BitNet samt givetvis i MS Office. Kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift, meriterande.

Vi ser gärna att du har ett kontaktnät på respektive ort med omnejd och att du trivs i att nätverka för att stärka vårt varumärke.

Tjänsten är heltid på dagtid.

Känner du igen det i det vi söker?

Då är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan eller dina frågor om tjänsten. I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Oak Consulting.

Ansvarig rekryteringskonsult är Helena Fiedler som nås på telefon 070-5919033. Vi vill ha din ansökan snarast – dock senast 8 november.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. 


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
