Experienced Milker Wanted for a Modern Jersey Dairy Farm in North Jutland

Would you like to be part of a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and professionalism?

A well-managed dairy farm near Vrå (9760) is looking for an experienced employee for milking and other barn-related tasks. The farm has been operated with great passion and professional expertise for more than 42 years and has built a strong workplace culture where employees support one another, show mutual respect, and share responsibility for the daily work.

The farm is home to approximately 900 Jersey cows and operates with modern facilities and well-established routines that ensure high animal welfare standards and a positive working environment.

About the Position

We are looking for a new team member to strengthen the workforce and help maintain the high standards of daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Milking in a modern 60-point rotary milking parlor
  • Bedding cubicles
  • Washing and cleaning
  • General barn duties

Three employees are involved in the milking operation, and tasks are rotated according to a schedule, providing variety throughout the working week.

Working Hours

Milking takes place:

  • 03:00 - 08:00
  • 15:00 - 19:30

Weekend work is included according to a rotating schedule.

Typically, you will:

  • Work both morning and afternoon milking shifts 1-2 times per week

There is a shared morning coffee break at 08:00, where colleagues meet and coordinate the day's tasks.

Who Are You?

  • Have experience milking dairy cows

  • Have an interest in dairy farming and agriculture
  • Thrive in a structured work environment with routines and responsibilities
  • Are reliable and flexible
  • Are friendly and team-oriented
  • Take initiative and approach challenges with a solutions-focused mindset

A driver's license is not required.

We Offer

  • Permanent employment with the possibility of many years of service
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications
  • A stable and professionally managed workplace with 42 years of experience
  • An international working environment with both Danish and foreign colleagues
  • Supportive colleagues who help one another
  • A workplace where respect, cooperation, and professionalism are a natural part of everyday life

The team currently consists of approximately 20 employees, including colleagues from Denmark, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, and Eritrea.

Please contact Tetiana if you want more information. The job is as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Lindevangskolen søger pædagog til vores specialrække
jobs.description:
Pædagog med hjerte og høj faglighed til vores specialrække – Bliv en del af et stærkt hold med store frihed under ansvar.

Drømmer du om en hverdag med frihed under ansvar, står indflydelse og reel medbestemmelse? Vil du være med til at præge retningen og bruge din pædagogiske faglighed i et stærkt og hjertevarmt team, hvor dine idéer bliver til virkelighed? Vil du indgå i en arbejdsplads hvor du får lov til at være noget for nogen?

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i vores special række på Lindevangskolen.

Vi søger en pædagog, som brænder for specialområdet, der er forankret i sin faglighed, tør tænke ud af boksen og som vil have reel og direkte indflydelse på vores dagligdag og samt udvikling af vores praksis.

Stillingen er på 37 timer og er til besættelse hurtigst muligt.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en specialrække på en almen folkeskole, med børn fra børnehaveklassen til og med 6. klasse. Vi er en arbejdsplads, hvor der er kort vej fra tanke til handling og hvor vi vægter frihed under ansvar højt.

Vi lægger ikke skjul på at specialområdet kan være krævende, med en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor tempoet ofte er højt, men hos os står du aldrig alene. Vi prioriterer fast faglig sparring, et tæt makkerskab og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til grin og gode ideer.

Hverdagen hos os

Hos os arbejder vi med børn med og uden diagnoser. Fællers for dem alle er dog at de har brug for en ekstra tydelig struktur, forudsigelighed og specialpædagogisk støtte for at kunne trives og udvikle sig. Din hverdag kommer til at veksle mellem:

  • At skabe faste, trygge rammer og genkendelige rutiner for børnegruppen.
  • At understøtte og udvikle sociale kompetencer og trivsel i både undervisningsmiljøet, frikvartererne og SFO-tiden.
  • Have teten på pædagogiske aktiviteter. Dette både inde og ude. I gymnastiksalen, musik eller sløjdlokalet, i svømmehallen eller når vi er på tur med eller uden vores minibus. Eller hvad Du måtte brænde for.
  • Mægle i konflikter og have øje for det forebyggende pædagogiske arbejde, for at disse ikke opstår.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager B2B Telecom SaaS
jobs.description:
VX Fiber | Stockholm | Full-time

VX Fiber is looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Manager to take ownership of our marketing and help us generate more qualified sales opportunities across our international markets.

You will turn commercial priorities into a focused marketing plan—and deliver it. From sharpening our product messaging and creating campaigns to building HubSpot workflows and improving our website, you will combine sound marketing judgement with practical execution.

As our main marketing owner, you will work closely with sales, product, leadership, agencies and marketing specialists.

The role

This role suits someone who enjoys both deciding what needs to happen and making it happen. You can identify the right audiences, explain a complex technology offering clearly, and build campaigns that move potential customers from initial interest to a meaningful sales conversation, experirence in technology marketing and ideally B2B telecommunicaitons is highly valued.

You will have ownership of marketing planning, delivery and improvement, with the opportunity to shape how marketing develops at VX Fiber.

What you’ll do

    Own the marketing plan. Translate business and sales priorities into clear audiences, campaigns, budgets and measurable objectives. Make deliberate choices about where to focus time and resources.
    Generate qualified demand. Plan, build and improve campaigns across our website, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels, taking responsibility for the content and execution.
    Work closely with sales. Agree target customers, qualification criteria and follow-up processes. Use feedback from sales conversations to improve targeting, messaging and lead quality.
    Lead product and solution messaging. Turn technical capabilities, customer insights and commercial benefits into clear positioning for network owners, service providers and other relevant buyers.
    Improve our website and content. Create and maintain product pages, campaign pages, customer stories and clear calls to action that help visitors understand our offer and take the next step.
    Equip sales with useful materials. Develop presentations, one-pagers, case studies and campaign assets that support customer conversations and help opportunities progress.
    Measure performance and act on it. Track conversion, lead quality, opportunities and marketing’s contribution to pipeline. Use the findings to improve campaigns and guide investment.
    Manage external support. Brief and coordinate agencies or freelancers, manage agreed budgets, and maintain quality and consistency across their work.

What you’ll bring

    Typically five or more years of relevant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of owning and delivering marketing activity.
    Evidence of generating qualified demand and supporting sales pipeline, with the ability to explain what you delivered and what changed as a result.
    Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
    Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, commercially relevant content.
    Practical experience with digital campaigns, website content, email marketing and LinkedIn.
    Confidence working with sales, product specialists and senior leadership, including challenging assumptions and recommending priorities.
    The judgement to balance ambition with available resources, and the willingness to produce work yourself.
    Fluent English. Swedish is a strong advantage, and additional languages are welcome.

Experience in B2B technology, telecoms, fibre, infrastructure, SaaS or connectivity would be particularly valuable. Familiarity with longer sales cycles, account-based marketing and managing external specialists would also be an advantage.

Why join VX Fiber?

You will have real ownership, close collaboration with colleagues across the business, and the opportunity to make a visible commercial contribution.

You’ll work in an international environment, helping customers understand technology that supports reliable connectivity and the development of digital infrastructure.

Practical details

    Employment: Permanent, full-time.
    Location: Based in Stockholm.
    Work eligibility: You must have the right to work in Sweden.
    Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

About VX Fiber

VX Fiber enables fiber network owners and service providers to consolidate, automate, and scale operations and wholesale business models.

Founded in Sweden during the early development of open access fiber network build, now with over 20 years of operations, service delivery and software development experience, we deliver an OSS/BSS SaaS platform, engineering services and operational services.

jobs.title: Genopslag - kirketjener ved Ordrup Kirke 30 t. /ugen
jobs.description:
Har du praktisk sans, godt humør og lyst til at være en vigtig del af livet i en aktiv kirke?

Ordrup Kirke søger en engageret og alsidig kirketjener, der trives med en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er helt ens. Vi søger en kollega, som kan arbejde selvstændigt, planlægge og prioritere sine opgaver, og samtidig indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kirkens anden kirketjener Marie Barfoed, og kirkens øvrige medarbejdere.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en deltidsstilling på 30 timer. For den rette kandidat er menighedsrådet dog indstillet på at drøfte en udvidelse af arbejdsopgaverne med henblik på en fuldtidsstilling.

Vi søger en kirketjener, som:
  • gerne har erfaring som kirketjener eller fra en lignende stilling
  • har gode samarbejdsevner og en positiv tilgang til arbejdet
  • er imødekommende og har let ved at tale med mennesker
  • har god situationsfornemmelse og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver
  • har praktisk sans og hænderne skruet godt på

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:
  • klargøring af kirken og medvirken ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • rengøring og almindelig vedligeholdelse af kirken og sognegården
  • pasning af kirkens udendørsarealer
  • opstilling og flytning af borde og stole i forbindelse med arrangementer
  • indkøb og lagerstyring
  • opsyn med håndværkere, tekniske installationer og øvrig drift
  • andre praktiske opgaver, der bidrager til kirkens daglige liv

Stillingen indebærer fysisk arbejde, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med praktiske opgaver.

Vi arbejder løbende på at udvikle kirkens drift og skabe gode rammer for kirketjenernes arbejde. Blandt andet ønsker vi at skabe mulighed for ekstra ressourcer til særlige opgaver som hovedrengøring og større vedligeholdelsesopgaver, ligesom vi ser på mere bæredygtige løsninger i plejen af kirkens udearealer.

Vi tilbyder
  • et alsidigt og meningsfuldt arbejde i en levende kirke
  • gode og engagerede kolleger
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar og udvikling
  • mulighed for at præge stillingens fremtidige indhold

Ansættelse sker ved Ordrup Sogns Menighedsråd beliggende Henrik Hertz Vej 1, 2920 Charlottenlund.

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på Folkekirkens IntraNet.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.667,- kr. – 408.841,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

OK tillæg på 1.401,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling) pr. år.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

Løn OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

Hvis du ikke er uddannet kirketjener, er det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kirketjenere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Odborní pracovníci v oblasti predaja poistenia
jobs.employer: KOMUNÁLNA poisťovňa, a.s. Vienna Insurance Group
jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície. Všetky informácie o spracúvaní osobných údajov nájdete na https: www.kpas.sk stranka ochrana-osobnych-udajov.

Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

We are looking for an HR Assistant with a generalist profile to support the full employee lifecycle in our Bratislava office. The role combines recruitment, HR administration, employee support, reporting, and coordination of internal HR processes.

Responsibilities
Support recruitment from vacancy publication and candidate screening to interviews and offers.
Coordinate onboarding, probation, internal transfers, and offboarding.
Prepare HR documents and maintain accurate employee records.
Update information in HR systems and prepare regular headcount reports.
Respond to employees’ questions regarding HR policies and internal procedures.
Coordinate performance reviews, training, benefits, and employee-development activities.
Support foreign employees with relocation, residence, and employment documentation.
Communicate with external providers and relevant Slovak authorities.
Assist with company events and employee-engagement initiatives.
Ensure confidentiality and compliance with internal HR standards.

Requirements
At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Good command of Slovak.

Nice to have
Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.title: Technici počítačových sietí a systémov
jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.
Follow established change-management, security, and documentation procedures.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

jobs.title: Lead Elder / Voorganger
jobs.description:
Ervaring met prediking, pastorale zorg, kerkelijk leiderschap en het toerusten en begeleiden van gemeenteleden en medewerkers.

Grace Church Amsterdam is an English speaking Christian church serving an international community in Amsterdam. We are seeking a full time Lead Pastor and Lead Elder to provide pastoral, theological and organizational leadership to the church.

The Lead Pastor will serve as a Staff Elder and work together with our lay elders. Responsibilities include preaching regularly, overseeing Sunday worship gatherings, leading elder meetings, providing pastoral care, equipping church members for discipleship and evangelism, developing future elders and deacons, supervising staff, and overseeing the day to day operations of the church.

The candidate must be able to affirm the doctrinal statement of Grace Church without reservation. We are seeking a pastor committed to expository preaching, the authority and inerrancy of Scripture, complementarian convictions, and Reformed soteriology.

Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required. The candidate must be able to preach, teach, provide pastoral care, lead meetings, and supervise staff in an English speaking church environment.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter explaining their relevant ministry experience and interest in serving Grace Church Amsterdam.

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Ben jij de accountmanager die nieuwe kansen om zet naar langdurige relaties? Lees dan snel verder.

G-Nius zoekt een enthousiaste accountmanager:

Als Account Manager ben je commercieel gedreven, ondernemend, energiek, verkoop- en resultaatgericht. Daarbij beschik je over een flinke dosis doorzettingsvermogen. Je bent een verbinder, je genereert ideeën en zoekt naar creatieve mogelijkheden om nieuwe opdrachtgevers aan G-Nius te binden. Je werkt proactief aan een solide en langdurige samenwerking met zowel opdrachtgevers als met professionals.

Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar het maken van de perfecte match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers. Je maakt hiervoor gebruik van jouw eigen netwerk als het zakelijk netwerk van G-Nius.

Wat ga je doen?

Offer Description
The main aim of this interdisciplinary project is to achieve minimal life based on chemical rather than biological components such as DNA, proteins or other macromolecules. Our PhD candidate will contribute by developing new microfluidic tools to work with micrometer-sized coacervate droplets, the compartments in which chemical replication, growth and evolution will take place.
What are you going to do?
The de-novo synthesis of life requires integrating the essential features of life, which include replication (the ability to copy oneself), metabolism (promoting the formation of one's own components from material in the environment) and compartmentalization (keeping the internal components together and separate from the environment) into a system that is maintained out of equilibrium. Key to the creation of a minimal form of life is Darwinian evolution of the resulting synthetic cell-like systems. Serving as the compartments in our work are coacervate microdroplets, consisting of a very dense aqueous phase containing a high concentration of macromolecules. Because coacervates can exist in dilute aqueous phases without loss of droplet structure, they can act as cell-like spheres without the need of a membrane to contain their content.

Your role
Final Project 1: Skill Management in Assembly
In the assembly department, more and more is being demanded of assembly workers. Due to increasing product complexity, customer diversity, and technological advancements, it is important to have a clear understanding of the knowledge and skills currently possessed by the team and those that are needed.
In this assignment, you will investigate how Moba can better manage and ensure the development, employability, and knowledge of its technicians. You will identify required and existing competencies and develop a practical proposal for skills management. In doing so, you will consider not only technical skills but also personal competencies that contribute to flexibility, quality, and long-term employability.
Final Project 2: Optimization of Work Allocation and Assembly Processes
Within the assembly of our main frames, we see opportunities to further optimize the division of labor and assembly times. In addition, we want to gain a better understanding of the causes of production losses within the process.
During this assignment, you will analyze the current division of labor, assembly times, and production output. You will investigate where bottlenecks occur and determine the extent to which production losses are caused by parts shortages or by inefficiencies in the assembly process. Based on your findings, you will make recommendations for improvements that contribute to more efficient and predictable production.

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 25,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and now expanding across Asia Pacific. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

Requirements

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

jobs.title: Gestionnaire des stocks (m/f)
jobs.description:
Au sein du service achat et en collaboration avec le service montage et le service dépannage, sous la supervision du Responsable achats, vous gérez et optimisez la gestion des stocks (entrées et sorties des marchandises) pour minimiser le niveau de stocks sans risquer la rupture. Vous aurez en charge de gérer les magasiniers.

Vos tâches et missions :

Vous gérez les différents stocks à partir d'un programme informatisé :
• Organisation des stocks : classement et rangement du matériel commandé de façon ordonnée et logique
• Visualisation et optimisation du flux de marchandises
• Approvisionnement des stocks
• Contrôle de l'accès aux stocks
• Propreté des stocks et du parc de recyclage
• Mise en place des inventaires mensuels et annuels

Vous supervisez et contrôlez les entrées et sorties de stock :
• Réceptions et livraisons de matériel, équipements, fournitures, etc.
• Contrôle de la qualité de la marchandise reçue
• Remontée et signalement des problèmes
• Transmission de l'arrivée de la commande au bon service

Vous préparez le matériel à livrer / pour les chantiers :
• Vérification du matériel pour chaque chantier
• Préparation des éléments annexes et de l'approvisionnement en consommables

Votre profil :
• Expérience minimale de 5 ans comme gestionnaire des stocks / magasinier
• Excellentes connaissances de la gestion des espaces et du stock
• Bonnes connaissances des logiciels de gestion et d'inventaire

jobs.title: IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in the domain of IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites.
Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks.
As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard an experienced IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to strengthen and manage our cloud-first IT infrastructure.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. You will play a key role in maintaining a secure, resilient, and well-documented infrastructure, driving infrastructure modernization initiatives, supporting users across the organization, and enabling the continued growth and success of OQ Technology.

Job Responsibilities

• Administer and support all types of endpoints (Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile) across the organization.
• Manage and support Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, conditional access, backups, and monitoring.
• Manage identity, access, and device management (Entra ID, Intune, MDM).
• Support secure collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, file sharing, conferencing), SharePoint Online administration, and licensing management (including CSP/NCE transitions).
• Maintain and optimize virtualization platforms (Proxmox or other hypervisors) and containerized environments where applicable.
• Manage and support AWS infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining EC2 instances and related resources.
• Handle user and access management on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Support and maintain secure remote access (OpenVPN, bastion hosts, jump servers) and general network infrastructure (switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing).
• Support system availability, performance, patching, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
• Manage backup and disaster recovery operations using Veeam, ensuring reliable backup jobs, retention policies, and recovery testing.
• Maintain and support self-hosted or cloud-based GitHub/GitLab instances, including user access, repository administration, and general upkeep.
• Apply security-by-design principles across all IT systems; support compliance with relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001) and internal security policies.
• Assist with vulnerability management, patching, audits, and risk assessments.
• Participate in infrastructure planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot complex system and virtualization issues across cloud environments.
• Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for the helpdesk team and end users.
• Document system configurations, procedures, architectures, and operational standards.
• Manage IT-related purchases (hardware, software licenses, cloud credits) in collaboration with procurement, and track asset lifecycle to optimize spend.
• Develop working knowledge of Linux systems and assist with Linux-based workloads as needed.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable IT infrastructure/operations role in a corporate environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure/Microsoft 365 administration (Entra ID, SharePoint Admin Center, conditional access, licensing).
• Solid understanding of virtualization concepts (Proxmox, Hyper-V, or similar).
• Experience managing AWS resources (EC2 instances and related services); familiarity with GCP user/access management is a plus.
• Solid networking knowledge, including OpenVPN administration, switches, firewalls, VLANs, and routing (TCP/IP).
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring solutions (Veeam experience is a strong plus).
• Comfortable working with enterprise ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) for incident and request management.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a preference for clear, GUI-driven administration tools where practical.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent documentation skills — comfortable producing clear operational guides and handover documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering Linux systems, or strong willingness to learn.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or comparable) as a complement to GUI-based administration.
• Exposure to containerization (Docker) and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform).
• Familiarity with maintaining GitHub/GitLab instances (user management, repository administration).
• Experience working within an international organization, comfortable navigating diverse cultures and multiple time zones.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Azure) are a plus.

Additional Information:

As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What We Offer

• A hands-on role with ownership across the full cloud IT stack and security.
• Direct exposure to infrastructure modernization and licensing/procurement decisions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

jobs.title: DSP Communications Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

DSP Communications Engineer

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in satellite IoT connectivity and next-generation non-terrestrial network (NTN) services. As the first company to seamlessly integrate standardized cellular technology with satellites, OQ Technology is transforming how connected devices communicate beyond the reach of terrestrial networks.
Our technology enables secure, scalable IoT connectivity for industries including Oil & Gas, Utilities, Mining, Agriculture, Maritime, Logistics, Transport, and Environmental Monitoring, helping organizations monitor and manage critical assets anywhere in the world.
As we continue to develop the payload for our satellite missions, we are looking for an experienced DSP Communications Engineer to join a multi-disciplinary team at our facility in Luxembourg. You will be the DSP Communications Engineer for the project and will be responsible for the DSP software and algorithm design for the telecommunication payload of OQ Technology's first satellite mission. jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What we offer:

• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary – an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU
Job ID: 10560220 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon's transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon's most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity.

You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future.

Key job responsibilities

-Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.

-Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
-Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. - Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.

In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions - and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.

• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions - data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of data lineage: source systems, metrics aggregation logic, and how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon by stakeholders

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
