jobs.title: Chauffeur - Executive Driver (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
Purpose

As Chauffeur / Executive Driver, you will ensure the safe, proactive, and discreet execution of driving duties for the CEO, senior leadership, and VIP guests. You will deliver a highly professional, representative and service-oriented driving experience, ensure the operational readiness and safety of the company vehicle, seamlessly support key logistical and administrative tasks for both Executive/Board Services and Facility Management, actively contributing to projects and archiving activities.

Accountabilities

Executive Driving

Conduct driving assignments for the CEO, senior leadership, and VIP guests within Switzerland (and internationally/near borders as required).
Provide safe, smooth, and comfort-oriented driving; maintain situational behavior under elevated security requirements.
Ensure professional reception, care, and logistics for visitors/guests (e.g., at airports/hotel), including luggage handling and coordination with reception/security.
Perform independent route and schedule planning, proactively considering traffic, roadworks, weather, security situations, and alternative routes.
Execute courier trips, errands, and transport sensitive documents/materials with the utmost care and confidentiality.
Coordinate and prioritize driving assignments; align with the CEO Office, Executive Assistants, and Board Secretariat.
Demonstrate high flexibility (e.g., short-term changes, waiting times, evening appointments) within the framework of working hours regulations.
Ensure compliance with all legal regulations (Swiss Road Traffic Act - SVG, rest/working hours if applicable, safety regulations) and internal policies.
Vehicle Management

Ensure the care, cleaning, and value preservation of the company vehicle (interior/exterior), including fuel and charging management.
Guarantee operational safety: conduct routine checks of tyres, fluids, lighting; schedule/coordinate servicing, tyre changes, MFK (mandatory vehicle inspection) and repairs.
Facilities Management Support

Collaborate closely with the Facility Management team during driving downtimes.
Assist with various activities within the Facilities Management area, such as archiving and project support.
Qualifications
Completed vocational training or equivalent qualification.
Valid Category B driving license (mandatory); Category 121 (professional passenger transport) is a plus.
Minimum of 4-5 years of experience as an Executive Driver, Chauffeur, or in a comparable service/security role (e.g., VIP transport, hotel/concierge, corporate aviation).
Proven experience in dealing with senior executives and/or VIP guests.
Good working knowledge of English, both written and spoken, and solid German language skills are required. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.
Excellent driving skills with a strong focus on safety; completed specialized advanced driving courses (e.g. defensive driving, safety or security driving training) are a plus.
Valid First Aid / CPR certification (or willingness to acquire/renew it).
Very good knowledge of the Swiss road network (including major transit routes, airports, hotels, and business locations) or willingness to learn this.
Basic technical understanding of vehicles to identify and coordinate maintenance needs.
Absolute discretion, trustworthiness, and confidentiality in handling sensitive information; professional, reserved demeanor.
High service orientation and flexibility regarding working hours: assignments may occur early in the morning, evenings, and occasionally on weekends; short-term adjustments are possible.
Additional Information
We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will benefit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working arrangements, an attractive bonus system, an onsite doctor, a fitness room, a canteen, and other benefits such as family-friendly initiatives and child and family allowances.
Please submit your complete application, including an English CV, cover letter, copies of diplomas/certificates, and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Field Service Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Artidis

Artidis is a pioneering clinical stage health technology company that aims to set the gold standard in tissue analysis and therapy optimization. By combining its nanotechnology platform for rapid tissue analysis with a holistic data solution, Artidis accelerates drug discovery, tissue engineering, and personalized treatment. Artidis focuses its research and development efforts on solid tumors to enhance responses to chemo, immuno, and cell therapies, driving precision in cancer care.

Job Purpose

The Field Service Team Lead is responsible for coordinating and guiding field service activities to ensure successful system installations, reliable device performance, and timely resolution of technical issues in the field. The role provides technical leadership to field service engineers and ensures proper communication and alignment between field operations and internal engineering teams.

By managing installation activities, supporting troubleshooting and escalation processes, and coordinating with product development and operations teams, the Field Service Team Lead helps maintain high service quality and supports the continuous improvement of Artidis systems deployed in the field.

Duties and Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate the activities of Field Service Engineers globally.
Develop and maintain comprehensive global service plans covering installations, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and risk mitigation.
Conduct risk assessments for all service activities and site operations to ensure safety, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Plan and manage global travel schedules and service logistics for all site visits.
Support Field Service Engineers in diagnosing and resolving complex software and hardware issues.
Prepare service estimations and resource planning for upcoming installations and site visits worldwide.
Define, review, and maintain service documentation, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and templates to ensure regulatory compliance and operational consistency.
Prioritize service requests, manage escalation paths, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with R&D, software, hardware, production, and quality teams.
Perform in-depth reviews of engineering change lists and releases to assess field impact and define service implementation plans.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to field service engineers and service technicians.
Communicate field feedback to product management and development teams to drive continuous improvement.
Conduct bi-weekly reports to the Head of Device Operations summarizing service activities, key metrics, and escalations.
Hold regular one-on-one meetings with team members to provide guidance, feedback, and support professional development.
Provide structured feedback from the field to product management and development teams to drive continuous improvement.
Provide occasional on-site support for installations, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance on a global basis. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 5 years experience in field service, technical support, or service operations, preferably in medical devices or complex technical systems.
Proven experience leading and managing field service teams, including 1:1s, performance coaching, and team development.
Strong expertise in software and hardware troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and risk assessment for field operations.
Experience in global service planning, travel coordination, resource allocation, and service estimation.
Familiarity with medical device regulations (FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304) and technical documentation practices.
Excellent organizational, planning, and communication skills, with experience in cross-functional collaboration across R&D, software, hardware, production, and quality teams.
Ability to work independently while providing technical leadership and guidance to a globally distributed team.
Experience in reporting, metrics tracking, and structured service documentation.
Willingness and ability to travel globally.

Working Conditions

The environment is a typical start-up with an intrinsically motivated international team. Our company is an excellent place for rapid advancement and offers a promising opportunity to learn and share know-how in a very agile environment. The position requires the employee to go the extra mile when needed. We are looking for a team player who appreciates direct communication. The effort is rewarded with challenging tasks, the possibility to take responsibility, a highly driven team, and work serving a significant purpose. The job position comes with a competitive salary and a bonus for outstanding performance.

Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at a regulated fintech institution
================================================================

**About Us**

We are a Zurich\-based, FINMA\-regulated financial institution operating at the intersection of traditional banking, payments, embedded finance and blockchain technology.

We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on banking executive to serve as Chief Executive Officer (CEO), with a strong track record in the Swiss or European banking sector and substantial experience in Financial Institutions (FI), Global Corporate Banking and/or High\-Net\-Worth Individuals (HNWI).

The successful candidate should combine solid banking experience, strong commercial and relationship\-management capabilities, and a deep understanding of operating a regulated financial institution.

**Your Role**

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the day\-to\-day management and sound operation of the Company.

You will lead and coordinate the Company’s key functions, ensure that its organisation and control framework meet the standards expected of a regulated financial institution, and work closely with the Board of Directors on the Company’s strategy and development.

A key part of the role will be to strengthen the Company’s position within the Swiss and international banking ecosystem, including relationships with banks, financial institutions, corporate clients and other key stakeholders.

You will also act as a principal representative of the Company towards FINMA, banking partners, clients and the broader financial community.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Overall Management \& Banking Operations:** Lead the day\-to\-day operations of the Company and assume overall executive responsibility for running a regulated financial institution. Coordinate key functions including Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology and Business Development. Ensure that the Company’s organisation, processes, controls and resources are appropriate for its business activities and regulatory obligations. Implement the strategy and priorities agreed with the Board of Directors.
* **Financial Institutions \& Banking Relationships:** Develop and maintain senior\-level relationships with Swiss and international banks, correspondent banks and other financial institutions. Manage and expand relationships with payment and financial infrastructure partners, including SWIFT, SEPA\-related institutions, card organisations and other banking service providers. Represent the Company in discussions and negotiations with banking partners and financial institutions. Support the development of the Company’s international banking network and institutional partnerships.
* **Corporate \& Institutional Client Development:** Contribute banking expertise to the development of the Company’s corporate and institutional client business. Bring a strong understanding of client needs across payments, transaction banking, cash management, treasury, foreign exchange (FX), liquidity management and cross\-border financial services. Contribute relevant treasury and FX expertise, including liquidity management, currency exposure, FX execution and related risk management. Ensure that commercial development remains consistent with the Company’s risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
* **Governance, Risk \& Compliance:** Ensure effective governance, risk management and internal controls across the Company. Work closely with Compliance and Risk to ensure compliance with Swiss regulatory requirements, AML/KYC standards and internal policies. Ensure timely remediation of regulatory and audit findings and appropriate follow\-up by management. Promote a strong risk and compliance culture throughout the organisation.
* **FINMA, Audit \& Regulatory Reporting:** Maintain a professional and constructive relationship with FINMA and other relevant authorities. Actively participate in financial and regulatory/compliance audits and maintain effective relationships with external accurate and timely regulatory, financial, tax and corporate reporting to FINMA, the Board of Directors, auditors and other relevant stakeholders.
* **Swiss \& International Financial Ecosystem:** Represent the Company within the Swiss banking and financial community. Maintain relationships with banks, industry associations, financial organisations and relevant working groups. Strengthen the Company’s connectivity with the broader Swiss and international financial sector.


**Candidate Profile**

We are particularly interested in candidates who have built their careers within established banks or regulated financial institutions.

**Required Experience:**

* 10\+ years of professional experience with a Swiss bank or major international bank, including substantial senior management responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in at least one, and preferably more than one, of the following areas: Financial Institutions (FI) / Correspondent Banking; Global Corporate Banking / Transaction Banking; Private Banking / HNWI / Family Office.
* Strong network within the Swiss and/or international banking sector, including senior relationships with banks, financial institutions and corporate or private clients.
* Practical experience dealing with FINMA and a strong understanding of the Swiss banking and regulatory environment.
* Strong understanding of AML/KYC, Risk Management, Corporate Governance and internal control frameworks.
* Solid understanding of banking accounting, financial statements, management reporting and regulatory reporting.
* Experience working with financial and regulatory auditors.


**Leadership Profile:**

* Proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams within a regulated financial institution.
* Strong commercial judgment combined with a sound risk and compliance mindset.
* Strong relationship\-building and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Able to operate both strategically and hands\-on in a relatively lean organisation.
* Comfortable representing the Company at senior level with regulators, banks, clients, shareholders and other external stakeholders.


**Additional Experience:**

* Experience in payments, transaction banking, cross\-border banking or digital banking is highly desirable.
* Understanding of embedded finance and modern payment infrastructure is an advantage.
* Knowledge of blockchain, DLT, stablecoins and digital assets is beneficial but not a prerequisite.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and .
* Swiss work permit or citizenship required.


**What We Offer**

* A senior executive role with overall responsibility for a FINMA\-regulated Swiss financial institution.
* The opportunity to lead the Company through its next stage of organisational and business development.
* Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international banking ecosystem.
* A hands\-on environment with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen. Wir begleiten Spitäler, Kliniken und Gesundheitsinstitutionen in allen Phasen der Digitalisierung – von strategischer Beratung über Prozessoptimierung bis zur Implementierung und zum Betrieb von IT-Lösungen. Als Teil der collana Gruppe verbinden wir Branchenexpertise im Gesundheitswesen mit technologischem Know-how.
 
Unsere Mission: Komplexe Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen durch smarte, integrierte und nachhaltige digitale Lösungen zu entschärfen. Wir streben danach, Effizienz zu steigern, Prozesse zu harmonisieren und die Qualität der Versorgungsleistung zu verbessern, unter Einhaltung höchster Standards in Datenschutz und Interoperabilität.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Consultant Health bist du eine Schlüsselperson in unserem Beratungsteam und agierst in folgenden Verantwortungsbereichen:

  • Projektleitung und Teilprojektleitung in Digitalisierungs- und IT-Transformationsprojekten im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategische und operative Beratung von Kunden (Spitäler, Kliniken, Pflegeinstitutionen etc.) entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette
  •  Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessdesign und Konzeption von IT-Lösungen (ERP, Schnittstellen, Systemintegration)
  • Begleitung und Steuerung der Einführung von Standardsoftware, insbesondere im ERP-Umfeld (z. B. Dynamics 365 Business Central)
  • Sicherstellung der technischen und fachlichen Qualität, inkl. Testmanagement, Change- und Betriebsüberführung
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung und Beteiligung an Akquisitionsaktivitäten
  • Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Fachseite, IT/Architektur, Entwicklung und Betrieb
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios und Mitwirkung an internen Innovationen
Oder
  • Führung von komplexen Transformationsprogrammen (klassisch oder agil) im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategieberatung für Kunden – Entwicklung von Digitalisierungsstrategien mit Fokus auf Governance, Interoperabilität, Datenschutz und Effizienz
  • Analyse von Prozessen entlang der Patient Journey, Tarifsystemen, Abrechnungssystemen, Supply Chain im Gesundheitsbereich
  • Konzeption von modularen IT-Lösungen, E-Health-Szenarien, Systemintegrationen und Datenarchitekturen
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung, Kundenworkshops und Stakeholder-Management
  • Steuerung der Umsetzung: Teil- oder Gesamtprojektleitung, Qualitätssicherung, Änderungsmanagement, Testbegleitung
  • Übergabe in Betrieb / Managed Services, Sicherstellung eines nachhaltigen Handovers
  • Mitwirkung in der Weiterentwicklung des Leistungsportfolios, Einführung neuer Services / Lösungen


Das bringst Du mit

  • Hochschulabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizininformatik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder vergleichbar)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder Umsetzung von IT- bzw. Digitalisierungsprojekten, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen
  • Erfahrung in Prozessanalyse, Konzeption und Einführung von ERP-Systemen bzw. modularen IT-Lösungen
  • Vertrautheit mit Schnittstellen, IT-Architekturen und Integrationskonzepten
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse von Standards und Technologien im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. HL7, FHIR, IHE)
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales, Angebotserstellung oder Akquise wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, pragmatische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Kundenorientierung und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Selbstständige und vertrauenswürdige Arbeitsweise mit Verantwortungsübernahme
  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Teamarbeit und Innovationsprojekten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (Italienisch und Französisch von Vorteil)


Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Ein professionelles Umfeld mit spannenden Projekten im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Einbindung in strategische Themen
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zugang zu Innovationen und Austausch im collana IT Netzwerk
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, Teilzeitmodelle möglich
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit der Option auf hybrides Arbeiten
Rahmenbedingungen:
  • Arbeitspensum: 80-100%
  • Standort: Büro in Bern und Winterthur, Einsätze schweizweit
  • Eintrittstermin: nach Vereinbarung
Wenn dich die Aufgabe reizt, mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mit digitalen Lösungen mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse).Für Fragen steht dir deine Recruiterin Julia ----- gerne zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Security guard
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

Your Qualifications

  • Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

  • Have several years of experience from a similar position

  • Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

  • Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

  • Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Work in a structured and independent manner

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible

  • Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

jobs.title: Er du SuperUsers' nye dataspecialist og -instruktør?
jobs.description:
Er du stærk inden for data, og har du lyst til at fordybe dig fagligt, arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data og AI og lære fra dig som kursusinstruktør? Så er du måske vores nye fuldtidskollega!

Vi søger en teknisk stærk og nysgerrig dataperson med et solidt fagligt fundament og lyst til løbende at udvide det. Særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python er centrale teknologier i rollen, suppleret af Power BI og SQL som vigtige dele af værktøjskassen. Dataområdet udvikler sig hurtigt i takt med AI, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med teknologier og løsninger i krydsfeltet mellem data, analytics og AI.

Undervisningserfaring er ikke et krav. Det er derimod vigtigt, at du har lyst til at formidle, forklare og gøre komplekse tekniske emner forståelige og anvendelige for andre.

Om SuperUsers A/S
SuperUsers er et danskejet IT-kursus- og konsulenthus, stiftet i 1984. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og Aarhus. I Hillerød får du din daglige gang på Karlebogaard, en historisk landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i nogle helt unikke rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med ca. 20 kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør
Din primære opgave bliver at undervise og afholde tekniske kurser for IT- og datafolk. Du kommer til at arbejde med og undervise inden for vores dataområder og får rig mulighed for løbende at udvide med nye teknologier og fagområder. Vi lægger stor vægt på at følge udviklingen tæt, og du får derfor både tid og mulighed for faglig fordybelse, selvstudie, kurser og sparring med vores øvrige instruktører.

På sigt vil cirka halvdelen af din tid være undervisning. Den øvrige tid vil blandt andet gå med forberedelse, udvikling af kurser og labs, opdatering af undervisningsmateriale, faglig udvikling samt konsulent- og kundeopgaver afhængigt af aktuelle behov.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Undervise inden for særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python, samt Power BI, SQL og relaterede dataområder.

  • Formidle data engineering, analyse og moderne dataplatforme på en jordnær og anvendelig måde.

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist – bliv ekspert i én branche
jobs.description:
Hjælp top 1 % med at blive endnu rigere
Fuldtid · Fysisk på kontoret ved Vesterport, København · Start hurtigst muligt

På Vinduespudserskolen starter man typisk som elev, fordi man drømmer om mere frihed i sin hverdag.

Det er helt simpelt. Forestil dig, at vinduespudseren kommer ud til en kunde på det tidspunkt, der passer ham. Han pudser huset hele vejen rundt på 5 minutter, systemet sender automatisk en faktura på 399 kr. til kunden og navigerer ham videre til næste kunde på vejen.

Så kan man selv regne på det. Gør du det én gang om dagen, 22 dage om måneden, har du 8.778 kr. i omsætning. Gør du som de andre, bare 15 gange om dagen, omsætter du for 131.670 kr. om måneden. Og så er der selvfølgelig dem, der præsterer det dobbelte, og dem, der snart runder 1 mio. kr. om måneden (hvor deres ansatte udfører opgaven, ansatte de også får oplært på skolen)

Et opslag skal jo have en fængende overskrift, men for at forklare den: Modellen har været udgangspunktet for, at vi har hjulpet mange af vores elever til at blive blandt de 1 % rigeste i deres aldersgruppe. Typisk folk, der ikke passede ind i den traditionelle skole.

Kort sagt er det grundlaget for Vinduespudserskolen. Med systemer og intensiv træning, fra håndværket nede på skolen til hele forretningen, fx at sælge til højere priser og med hyppigere intervaller, optimerer vi for eleverne. Vi er et fuldtidsteam, der ikke laver andet end at støtte, udvikle og træne vores elever i det, de har brug for.

Når eleverne har lært at sælge gode priser, gode intervaller og mange naboer, hjælper vi dem også med at reinvestere en del i tiltag som Meta Ads. Det må dog aldrig være deres eneste kilde til nye kunder.

Det er her, du kommer ind

Malte står i dag for at køre annoncer for en lang række elever. De sidste 4 år har han ikke lavet andet end at skaffe de bedste kunder til vinduespudserfirmaer, så han har en stor specialviden på området. Nu er vi nået dertil, hvor vi gerne vil have en ekstra person med på teamet til at arbejde sammen med Malte.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Meta Ads, som du kan vise frem. Google Ads er et plus, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du aldrig bliver helt tilfreds og hele tiden vil finde ud af, hvordan en kampagne kan blive bedre.

Du følger med i, hvad der sker med AI, og bruger det aktivt, fx med Make, til at automatisere rapportering og de opgaver, vi gør igen og igen. Ikke for at gøre tingene med hovedet under armen, men for at frigive tid, så vi kan bruge den på det, der gør en forskel for eleverne: at forstå dem, tale med dem og give dem et bedre og mere personligt produkt.

Du kommer til at holde møder med eleverne og være med på hele funnelen, fra annonce til hjemmeside. Hjemmesiderne udliciterer vi i dag, men dem vil vi gerne lave selv fremover. Og så skal du have lyst til at blive rigtig dygtig til ét område.

Opfylder du ikke alle punkter, men kan du genkende dig selv i det meste, så søg alligevel.

Hvem du er

Du starter med en intensiv oplæring. Vi forestiller os, at du tager ansvar for det, du har lovet en elev, og leverer det. Du er punktlig med dine aftaler og forventer det samme af andre. Og du kan lide at arbejde i et team.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst team, der gerne vil have, at du udvikler dig sammen med os. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuldtid, og du arbejder fysisk fra vores kontor ved Vesterport i København. Vi vil gerne have dig med hurtigst muligt.

Sådan søger du

Før du søger, så gå ind på Vinduespudserskolens YouTube og få et indtryk af, hvilken type virksomhed vi er.

Send derefter en kort ansøgning til job@vinduespudserskolen.dk med emnet "Paid Social – dit navn". Fortæl os, hvorfor du mener, du er den rette til jobbet.

jobs.title: Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown
jobs.description:
Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown

Vil du jobbe tett på ledelsen, internasjonale prosjekter og beslutningene som faktisk betyr noe?

Podtown er i sterk utvikling og bygger nå organisasjonen for neste fase. Vi utvikler og leverer modulære rom- og infrastrukturløsninger til krevende markeder som forsvar og beredskap. Nå søker vi en Business Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapet – tett på ledelsen, prosjektene og den operative virksomheten.

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell controllerrolle hvor hovedoppgaven er å rapportere på det som allerede har skjedd. Vi ser etter deg som vil forstå hva som skjer i virksomheten, se fremover og bidra til bedre beslutninger.

Regnskapet håndteres i stor grad eksternt. Din viktigste jobb blir derfor å sørge for at Podtown har kontroll på prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser, marginer og økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen skal være Podtowns interne økonomiske kontrollpunkt og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen.

En rolle med reell påvirkning

Podtown har en liten og kompetent organisasjon og arbeider med komplekse leveranser mot internasjonale kunder. Selskapet har etablert seg i forsvarsmarkedet og står foran en fase hvor både prosjektene og organisasjonen skal skaleres.

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle. Du vil blant annet:

  • etablere og følge opp prosjektbudsjetter, faktiske kostnader, committed cost, forecast, inntekter og marginer

  • bygge og følge opp rullerende likviditets- og cash flow-prognoser

  • analysere avvik og bidra til at tiltak blir satt inn tidlig

  • etablere en enkel og robust struktur for månedsrapportering, periodiseringer og avsetninger

  • arbeide tett med prosjektansvarlige, leverandører og produksjonspartnere for å forstå kostnadsdrivere, kapasitet og risiko

  • utarbeide økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag og rapportering til CEO, styre og eiere

  • støtte selskapet i dialog med bank, revisor, regnskapsfører og øvrige rådgivere

  • bidra i finansierings-, garanti-, forsikrings- og kapitalprosesser

  • bygge Podtowns egne økonomiske arbeidsprosesser og systemer etter hvert som virksomheten vokser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har noen års erfaring fra controlling, prosjektøkonomi eller økonomistyring og nå ønsker deg nærmere både virksomheten og beslutningene.

Du kan for eksempel arbeide som Business Controller, Project Controller, prosjektøkonom eller Financial Controller i dag. Erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri, maritim sektor, energi eller tilsvarende vil være relevant, men er ikke et absolutt krav.

Vi ser særlig etter deg som har:

  • høyere utdanning innen økonomi, finans eller regnskap

  • gjerne rundt 3–7 års relevant erfaring

  • god forståelse for regnskap og økonomiske sammenhenger

  • interesse for prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser og business partnering

  • gode ferdigheter i Excel og god systemforståelse

  • evne til å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger forståelige og beslutningsrelevante.

Like viktig er hvordan du jobber.

Du trives i et miljø med tempo, korte beslutningsveier og tydelige forventninger. Du er selvstendig nok til å drive egne områder fremover, men samtidig trygg nok til å diskutere, utfordre og sparre med ledelsen når tallene tilsier det.

Du trenger ikke være den som alltid har det mest kompliserte regnearket. Viktigere er det at du forstår hva tallene betyr, ser hva som krever handling og klarer å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger konkrete og beslutningsrelevante.

Vi tror du vil lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • tar eierskap og følger opp til ting faktisk er ferdige

  • arbeider strukturert og trives med ansvar

  • er analytisk, men også pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • kommuniserer tydelig på både norsk og engelsk, og tør å stå for egne faglige vurderinger

    bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt på tvers

  • trives med frihet innen tydelige rammer

Hvorfor Podtown?

Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor du faktisk kan være med og forme hvordan økonomifunksjonen skal fungere.

Du får:

  • stor påvirkning og kort vei fra analyse til beslutning

  • tett samarbeid med CEO, COO og selskapets ledelse

  • ansvar for økonomien i komplekse og internasjonale prosjekter

  • innsikt i et spennende marked med krevende kunder og leveranser

  • mulighet til å bygge systemer, arbeidsprosesser og rapportering – ikke bare overta dem

  • en rolle som kan utvikle seg mot et bredere økonomiansvar etter hvert som Podtown vokser.

Du vil få betydelig ansvar og handlingsrom, samtidig som det forventes fremdrift, kvalitet og selvstendighet i rollen.

Podtown passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker mer ansvar og større påvirkning enn du typisk får som én av mange controllere i et større konsern.

Grieg Gaarden, Bergen
Stillingen er 100 % og rapporterer til CEO.

jobs.title: Occupational Health and Wellbeing Executive SOC 1181

Employee Well-Being and Support -Develop evidence-based well-being programmes covering mental health, stress management, resilience, ergonomics, lifestyle health, and related areas. -Oversee the provision of Employee Assistance Programmes (EAPs) and other support services. -Promote a culture of well-being through awareness campaigns, training, and engagement activities. Safety, Compliance & Policy Development -Ensure organisational compliance with relevant Irish legislation, including the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act and industry-specific regulations. -Develop, update, and implement occupational health and well-being policies and procedures. -Provide expert guidance on incident management, workplace accommodations, and ergonomic assessments. -Maintain accurate and confidential health records in accordance with GDPR and professional standards. Strategic Leadership -Contribute to organisational strategy by integrating health and well-being objectives with business goals. -Lead cross-functional initiatives related to health and safety culture improvement. -Analyse occupational health data and produce regular reports for senior management. Training & Education -Deliver or coordinate training on occupational health, mental health awareness, ergonomics, hazard identification, and other relevant topics. -Build capacity among managers and employees to support health and well-being initiatives. jobs.title: Specialarbejder/maskinfører til Miljøcenter i Kolding
jobs.description:
Meldgaard har i mange år sorteret og håndteret affald, jord og genbrugsprodukter. I dag har vi miljøcentre/modtageanlæg i bl.a. Kolding, Klintholm, Herning og posesortering i Aalborg. Afdelingerne har været igennem en kraftig udvikling med masser af nye aktiviteter i en spændende branche.

Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have/park-affald, pap/papir og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 

Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Jobbet

Vi søger en specialarbejder til drift af vores helt nye presse på vores miljøcenter i Kolding. 
Du vil komme til at beskæftige dig med at overvåge pressen og kørsel af maskiner (gummiged, materialehåndteringsmaskine og gaffeltruck). Derudover vil du stå for sortering samt drift og vedligeholdelse af pladsen, pressen, maskiner samt alle forefaldende opgaver. Disse opgaver løses i samarbejde med driftslederen samt dine kommende kollegaer. 

Stillingen er på 37 timer, og arbejdstiden vil ligge mellem kl. 07.00 – 16.00.

Du vil blive en del af et lille team, hvor vi er hurtige til at træffe beslutninger og få opgaverne løst.

Om dig

Du har interesse og god forståelse for teknik samt maskiner og deres funktion. Dine hænder er skruet godt på, og du har erfaring eller interesse for kørsel af ballepresse, entreprenør- eller landbrugsmaskiner. Du elsker nye udfordringer, er omstillingsparat og vil gerne lære nyt. Du tager ejerskab i dit job og brænder for at gøre en forskel. 

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du: 
  • Er maskinfører
  • Kendskab til affaldssortering er en fordel
  • Har kørekort kategori B 
  • Fordel hvis du har erfaring med ballepresse
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig er en god teamplayer
  • Har godt humør
  • Har truckcertifikat
  • Er fleksibel

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Connie Westphal på tlf. 52 18 71 23.
Eller send os din ansøgning via Søg stillingen senest den 30. oktober 2026
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde!
jobs.description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper med hovedkontor i Bjordal, Høyanger. Konsernet driver en helhetlig verdikjede innen produksjon av ørret – fra genetikk og settefisk til matfiskproduksjon.

 

Vi søkjer ein strukturert og allsidig medarbeider som skal arbeide på tvers av konsernet.

 

Dette er ei brei og operativ rolle. Du vil støtte fleire fagområde og bidra til at oppgåver blir følgde opp på ein god og systematisk måte. Du vil jobbe med digitalisering og forenkling. Du motiveres av å skape struktur, sikre kvalitet og finne smartere og mer effektive måter å arbeide på.

 

Rolla passar for deg som likar variasjon. Du må trivast med å arbeide med både detaljar og større problemstillingar. Du vil få bred innsikt i selskapets verksemd og være bidragsyter for felles leveranser i konsernet.

 

Arbeidsoppgåver

 

Du vil få oppgåver innan fleire delar av verksemda, både innen verksemdsstyring og prosjekt. Innhaldet vil utvikle seg over tid.

 

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgåver vil vere:

  • Planlegging og gjennomføring av administrasjonsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for vedlikehold og arbeid i kvalitetssystem og interne rutinar etter årshjul
  • Forenkle og effektivisere administrative arbeidsprosesser, blant annet med bruk av KI.
  • Følge opp at lover, krav og interne retningslinjer blir etterlevd
  • Arbeid med rapportering fra prosjekt og støtte til prosjektorganisasjon i utviklingarbeid
  • Planlegge og drive mindre prosjekt, utviklingstiltak og forbedringsarbeid.
  • Støtte og oppfølging i revisjoner, kontroller og avvik.
  • Arbeid i system med arkivering, og oversikt over avtalar og dokumentasjon
  • Arbeid i informasjonskanalar og aktiv kommunikasjon
  • Administrativ støtte innan strukturelle system, utvikling og effektivisering
  • Innhente, strukturere dokumentasjon og styringsinformasjon på tvers av konsernet
  • Støtte økonomiarbeid med rapportering, dokumentasjon og oppfølging
  • Deltaking i prosjekt og forbetringsarbeid

 

Kven ser vi etter?

 

Vi ser etter ein person som er strukturert og nøyaktig. Du må like å få oversikt og sørgje for framdrift. Du har evne til å gripe om deg og er uredd i tilnærming til et større omfang.

 

Du arbeider sjølvstendig og er datakyndig. Samstundes må du kunne samarbeide godt med ulike delar av organisasjonen.

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har utdanning eller erfaring innan eitt eller fleire av desse områda:

 

  • Økonomi og administrasjon
  • Kvalitet eller HMS, juridiske/organisatoriske fag
  • Havbruksledelse

Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

 

Det viktigaste er at du har god forretningsforståing. Du må også vere komfortabel med å setje deg inn i nye fagområde og kunne sjå heilheten av kontinuerlig forbedring. Du er god i microsoft verktøy og spesielt Office 365.

 

Vi trur du vil lykkast dersom du

  • Arbeider systematisk og tek ansvar
  • Har høg gjennomføringsevne
  • Er god til å halde oversikt
  • Kommuniserer klart og presist
  • Behandlar konfidensiell informasjon på ein trygg måte
  • Likar å finne praktiske løysingar

 

Ei rolle med stor breidde

 

Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde.

 

Du vil arbeide i skjeringspunktet mellom kvalitet, etterleving og administrasjon. Du vil også støtte arbeid innan økonomi, HR, KHMS og juridiske saker. Vi er spesielt interessert dersom du har arbeid i skjeringspunktet mellom produksjon, økonomi og andre datautrekk.

 

Rolla gir derfor stor innsikt i korleis konsernet blir drive.

 

For den rette personen vil det vere gode moglegheiter til å utvikle både rolla og ansvarsområdet.

 

Vi tilbyr

 

  • Gode muligheter til å påvirke og videreutvikle konsernets prosesser og digitale løsninger.
  • Moderne systemer og digitale verktøy, samt gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et stabilt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø ved vårt avdelingskontor i Sandviken, Bergen.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

jobs.title: HSEQ Manager - Balance of Plant; Location: DK - Esbjerg, UK - Grimsby
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HSEQ professional with a passion for renewable energy and safe project delivery? Do you want to help shape safe, compliant and efficient Balance of Plant projects? Join us and become an energy pioneer in the industry!

Your position

In your new position as HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be a key member of our Renewables HSEQ function, supporting safe and compliant Balance of Plant project delivery across offshore wind projects. You will provide first-line HSEQ leadership, guide and support HSEQ Advisors, and work closely with Project Managers, the Head of BoP and operational teams to ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded from tender and pre-project preparation through to execution, reporting and lessons learned.

We are not just looking for someone who is technically qualified and experienced; we are looking for someone who shares our view of safety.

As part of the recruitment process, we will discuss how you see New View safety concepts, including Safety I and Safety II, HOP, and Safety Differently, working together to deliver safe outcomes. We will also explore how you believe the right information can be provided to the right people, whether that is controls for frontline workers, data for support teams, or due diligence information for leadership teams. In addition, we will discuss your perspective on the role of the HSEQ team in enabling learning, supporting operations and strengthening safe delivery.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient project delivery from sales and pre-project kick-off preparation through to project execution, operational learning, customer support and knowledge sharing.

  • Preparing and managing project-specific HSEQ documentation, including Project HSEQ Plans, Construction Phase Plans, emergency response plans, bridging documents, RAMS, LOTO input and supporting reference documents.

  • Supporting sales, tenders and project planning by reviewing contracts, identifying HSEQ deliverables and ensuring adequate costs and resources are planned for required HSEQ activities.

  • Preparing and contributing to kick-off meetings, project meetings and HSEQ presentations, ensuring relevant safety rules, evacuation arrangements, reporting requirements, initiatives, safety alerts and lessons learned are communicated.

  • Monitoring project execution, including completion of emergency response drill plans, weather day training plans, site visit quality, Synergy use, EFA kit compliance, action follow-up and investigation quality.

  • Leading or supporting significant investigations, ensuring clear descriptions, root causes, contributing factors, control measures and corrective and preventative actions are identified, tracked and closed effectively.

  • Maintaining professional relationships with client representatives, supporting positive safety culture, encouraging reporting and learning, and facilitating end-of-project lessons learned.



Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured, proactive and collaborative HSEQ professional who is passionate about offshore renewable energy and wants to leave their mark on safe project execution. You take ownership of HSEQ standards, are confident engaging with operational and project stakeholders, and can balance operational essentials with learning-focused activities that improve safety outcomes.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Solid HSEQ experience within offshore wind, marine, construction, renewables or other project-based operational environments.

  • Experience preparing, reviewing and maintaining HSEQ documentation such as RAMS, HSEQ plans, emergency response plans, drill plans, investigation reports and lessons learned material.

  • Confidence supporting tenders, contract reviews, project kick-off activities and HSEQ input to operational planning.

  • Experience guiding, supporting or leading HSEQ Advisors or site-based HSEQ personnel.

  • Strong investigation, reporting and follow-up skills, with the ability to identify trends, communicate areas of concern and drive actions through to completion.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work closely with Project Managers, clients, offshore teams and senior HSEQ leadership.

You will experience an international, inclusive and inspiring workplace where diversity, collaboration and a healthy work-life balance are not just buzzwords but integrated values that drive our success. We offer flexible working arrangements, on-site fitness facilities, and tasty, organic food in our canteen that will have your taste buds singing. Plus, we like to have fun along the way with lots of fun social activities!

Your place of work can be based either in the UK or Denmark, with regular collaboration across our international teams. The position is full-time, and you can expect travel to project and offshore locations as required, including site visits in line with project needs.

Become an energy pioneer

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Let’s drive change together. Apply today to leave your mark on the global energy industry.

As Assistant Kitchen Manager, you will be the Kitchen Manager’s right hand and an important part of the restaurant’s leadership team. You will work closely with the Kitchen Manager and General Manager and take active responsibility for daily kitchen operations, quality, structure and team development.

 

The position combines hands-on kitchen work with leadership, planning and follow-up. You will also play an important role in creating a strong team and ensuring that EGON’s routines and standards are implemented from day one. For the right candidate, this can also be an excellent step toward becoming a Kitchen Manager within EGON in the future.

Main Responsibilities
  • Support the Kitchen Manager in the daily operation of the kitchen
  • Take responsibility for kitchen operations when the Kitchen Manager is absent
  • Ensure consistently high food quality and presentation
  • Participate actively in food preparation and à la carte service
  • Follow up routines related to HACCP / food safety and hygiene
  • Help train, motivate and develop kitchen employees
  • Contribute to efficient staffing, planning and organization
  • Follow EGON’s routines, systems and operational standards
  • Help create a positive, structured and professional working environment
  • Contribute to building a strong kitchen team at the new restaurant
Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who enjoys responsibility and thrives in a busy restaurant environment.

 

You preferably have:

  • Relevant experience from a professional kitchen
  • Experience from high-volume restaurants or similar operations
  • Previous leadership experience, or a strong motivation to develop into a leadership role
  • Good organizational and communication skills
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to lead by example
  • The ability to remain structured and focused during busy services
  • A positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • A genuine interest in food, people and restaurant operations
  • Good communication skills in English. Speaking Norwegian is a big plus.

Experience as a Sous Chef, Assistant Kitchen Manager, Shift Leader, Team Leader or similar is an advantage.

What We Offer

At EGON Brygga, you will have the opportunity to join a completely new restaurant from the beginning and become part of building the team and operation. EGON offers a structured working environment with established systems, training and opportunities for professional development. As part of a large and growing restaurant group, there are also good opportunities for further career development for employees who want more responsibility.

 

You will become part of an ambitious leadership team in one of Tromsø’s most exciting new restaurant openings.

If you are an experienced kitchen professional who wants more responsibility and the opportunity to develop as a leader, we would like to hear from you.

 

Apply today and become part of the team opening EGON Brygga in Tromsø!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EGON Brygga will be a brand-new EGON restaurant opening at the historic Bangsundbrygga, directly on the waterfront in central Tromsø. The restaurant will have around 300 seats, including both indoor and outdoor seating. With its spectacular waterfront location and views of Tromsø’s surrounding mountains, EGON Brygga aims to become a natural meeting place for locals and visitors alike. The restaurant will offer EGON’s broad à la carte menu in a warm and informal atmosphere, while the design will preserve the historic character and architecture of Bangsundbrygga.

jobs.title: Udskolingslærer søges til Magleblik Skole
jobs.description:
HDS 

Magleblik Skole er i vækst – både på almen- og specialområdet – og søger derfor dygtige, relationsstærke og fagligt engagerede lærere til vores udskoling (6.-9. årgang).

Vi søger en lærer med kompetencer inden for HDS – gerne suppleret med engelsk eller tysk. Der er mulighed for både fuldtids- og deltidsansættelse.

Vi leder efter lærere, der brænder for at skabe stærke læringsfællesskaber, inspirerende undervisning og gode relationer til eleverne. Trives du i et tæt teamsamarbejde og ser mulighederne i en aktiv og praksisnær undervisning, kan Magleblik Skole være det rette sted for dig.

Om Magleblik Skole

På Magleblik Skole tror vi på, at alle børn kan lykkes. Vi ved også, at nogle elever skal arbejde hårdere, have mere støtte og møde flere forventninger end andre for at nå dertil.

Derfor søger vi en lærer, der brænder for både faglighed og relationer. En lærer, som insisterer på, at elevernes baggrund ikke skal afgøre deres muligheder i livet, og som vil være med til at bryde den sociale arv gennem stærk undervisning, tydelige fællesskaber og høje forventninger til alle.

Hos os bliver du en del af en skole, hvor vi arbejder målrettet for at løfte elevernes faglige niveau og trivsel. Vi er ambitiøse på elevernes vegne, fordi vi ved, at vores arbejde gør en forskel.

Magleblik Skole er en udviklingsorienteret skole med fokus på aktiv, engagerende og praksisnær læring. Vi vægter stærke relationer, tydelig klasseledelse og et tæt professionelt samarbejde højt.

Vores børnesyn er fundamentet for alt, hvad vi gør:

Børn kan være i problemer – men de er aldrig problemet.

Vi arbejder målrettet med læringsmiljøer, trivsel og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever. Samtidig er vi stolte af vores høje trivselsmålinger blandt både elever og medarbejdere.

De seneste år har vi blandt andet arbejdet med fagfornyelsens prøvehandlinger, udviklet og implementeret vores egen sprog- og læsestrategi og styrket matematikundervisningen gennem vejledere og fagudvalg. Vi udvikler os sammen – og vi forventer, at nye kolleger har lyst til at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling.

Dine opgaver

Du skal blandt andet:

  • planlægge og gennemføre inspirerende undervisning med fokus på læring, motivation og deltagelse
  • indgå aktivt i teamarbejde omkring elevernes faglige og sociale udvikling
  • være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen med stærke relationskompetencer
  • inddrage elevernes perspektiver i undervisningen
  • arbejde praksisnært og skabe sammenhæng mellem teori og virkelighed gennem varierede undervisningsformer
Vi forventer, at du
  • er uddannet lærer
  • har lyst til at arbejde med elever i udskolingen (6.-9. klasse)
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for elever med forskellige forudsætninger og behov
  • kan skabe trygge og udviklende undervisningsmiljøer
  • arbejder relationelt, anerkendende og professionelt
  • har fokus på trivsel, læring og tydelig klasseledelse
  • er fagligt nysgerrig, reflekterende og ambitiøs
  • trives i et forpligtende samarbejde og tager medansvar for fællesskabet
  • ser elevperspektivet som en vigtig del af udviklingen af undervisningen
Hos os får du

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • tæt teamsamarbejde
  • fokus på både elev- og medarbejdertrivsel
  • faglig sparring og videndeling
  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • et rummeligt, humoristisk og imødekommende lærerværelse

Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • et åbent og respektfuldt arbejdsmiljø præget af engagement og udvikling
  • mulighed for faglig og pædagogisk udvikling
  • gode rammer for bevægelse og praktisk undervisning
  • mulighed for deltagelse i Halsnæs i Bevægelse (HIB)

Et stærkt støtteapparat

  • adgang til specialpædagogisk konsulent, forebyggelseskonsulent, PPR og mellemformskonsulenter
  • tæt samarbejde om undervisningsmiljø og struktur
  • et nærværende og tilgængeligt ledelsesteam
Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker efter gældende overenskomst. Grundløn for laveste grundlønstrin er 39.293,85 kr./md. ekskl. pension. Derudover kan der aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest inden ansættelse.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Wenche Fogsgaard på 2164 3265

Ansøgningsfrist: 25. oktober 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler: Afholdes løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde nye kolleger velkommen på Magleblik Skole.

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør. 

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil. 
Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at bo og leve i Halsnæs? Besøg Flyt til Halsnæs og se, hvad området kan tilbyde dig og din familie.

jobs.title: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

  • Overall organization of the kitchen

  • Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

  • Staff scheduling

  • General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

  • Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

  • Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

  • Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

  • Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

Position: Kitchen Manager

All applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway at the time of application and must maintain this right throughout the agreed employment period.

Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must hold a valid Norwegian residence permit granting them the right to work in Norway when applying. Being eligible to apply for a permit is not sufficient. A residence permit issued by another European country does not automatically grant the right to work in Norway.

EU/EEA citizens must comply with applicable Norwegian registration requirements.

Applicants must provide documentation of their right to live and work in Norway with their application. Applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

No employee may start work without the necessary legal right and valid documentation.

✨ A unique season in beautiful Hardanger

✨ Competitive pay based on experience and responsibility

✨ A proper Norwegian employment contract

✨ Training and support

✨ Staff accommodation available for rent, subject to availability

✨ Staff meal arrangements

✨ Opportunities to develop and return for future seasons

IMPORTANT AVAILABILITY INFORMATION

As we are a seasonal hotel, applicants must be available throughout the agreed employment period.

Employees should not expect to take holidays during the operating season. Any planned holiday or absence must be disclosed during recruitment and discussed and approved in accordance with Norwegian legislation and the hotel's staffing requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short application in English.

Please include:

• The position you are applying for

• Relevant experience and references

• Your English and Norwegian proficiency

• Confirmation of your availability for the season

• Confirmation of your legal right to live and work in Norway

Vil du være den kommercielle motor i en dansk distributionsvirksomhed? Vi søger en ny kollega, der vil vinde nye kunder, udvide eksisterende kundeforhold og bygge de partnerskaber, der får forretningen til at vokse.

Det her er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du er specialist i et professionelt corporate miljø og har ansvar for hele kundeforløbet, fra det første kolde opkald til tilbud, ordre og opfølgning. Samtidig har du direkte kontakt med internationale leverandører. Du får frihed til at drive tingene fremad, men også forventninger om resultater, du kan måles på.

Dine ansvarsområder:

Nysalg

  • Opsøgende salg og cold calling til danske entreprenører, udlejningsvirksomheder og offentlige indkøbere

  • Ordrebekræftelser og opfølgning

Forretningsudvikling

  • Opbygning af partnerskaber med leverandører og virksomheder, herunder workshops og fælles aktiviteter

  • Rekruttering og understøttelse af forhandlere

  • Deltagelse i strategiplanlægning og koordinering mellem stakeholders på alle niveauer

Indkøb og forsyning

  • Daglig kontakt med internationale leverandører og producenter

  • Forhandling af priser, vilkår og leveringstider

  • Planlægning af transport til Danmark (fragt, Incoterms) og opfølgning, til varerne er på lageret

Marketing og drift

  • Drift af sociale medier (primært LinkedIn) og opdatering af hjemmesiden

  • Understøttelse af SEO gennem linkbuilding

  • Lagerstyring sammen med lageret i Danmark

Din hverdag:
Rollen har høj og målbar aktivitet. Vejledende er målet cirka 40 kundedialoger om dagen: ca. 10 indgående opkald, 20 samtaler med nye kunder og 10 opkald til eksisterende kunder. Resten af dagen bruges på Teams-møder, opfølgning, leverandører, forsendelser og sociale medier.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk i tale og skrift (alle kundesamtaler foregår på dansk)

  • Engelsk på business level, som du bruger dagligt med internationale leverandører

  • Dokumenteret B2B-salgserfaring med cold calling og resultater i at vinde nye kunder. Erfaring fra salgsbureau eller telemarketing er et stort plus

  • Styrke som forhandler over for både kunder og leverandører

  • Komfort med højt opkaldsvolumen og målbare mål

  • Hurtig på mail, struktureret og god til at multitaske

  • Evne til at håndtere stakeholders på alle niveauer

  • Godt kendskab til MS 365

  • Professionel og velpræsenteret fremtoning, der passer ind i et corporate miljø (skjorte og pæne bukser eller tilsvarende)

  • Dynamisk, proaktiv og selvkørende

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fast fra kontoret i Valencia og rejse til Danmark

  • Ønske om at blive i rollen i 2-3 år eller mere

  • Lyst til at lære, eller viden om, hvordan man køber ind internationalt og sender varer til Danmark (fragt, Incoterms og import)

Det er et plus, hvis du har

  • Erfaring fra byggebranchen, udstyrsudlejning, generatorer, pumper eller værktøj

  • Erfaring med at opbygge forhandler- eller partnerkanaler

  • Erfaring med indkøb eller import/logistik

  • CRM-disciplin, erfaring med LinkedIn-indhold og grundlæggende kendskab til SEO/linkbuilding

  • Kørekort, da der er kundebesøg i Danmark

Måske kommer du fra et salgsbureau, telemarketing eller et BPO-miljø og er klar til næste skridt: en specialistrolle, hvor du ejer relationerne og får indflydelse på resultaterne.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast grundløn på 2.000-2.600 EUR/md brutto, afhængigt af erfaring

  • Provision på dækningsbidrag: bonuspotentiale på 500-1.500 EUR/md uden loft

  • Targetløn op til 4.000 EUR/md brutto inkl. bonus

  • Fastansættelse på Contrato Indefinido

  • Direkte adgang til direktøren og indflydelse på strategien

  • Kontorliv i Valencia kombineret med jævnlige rejser til Danmark

Om virksomheden
Vi er en dansk distributionsvirksomhed, der leverer udstyr og materialer til bygge- og anlægsbranchen. Vi har specialiseret os i generatorer siden 2013 og samarbejder med førende europæiske producenter. Vores kunder er entreprenører, kommuner samt offentlige og private virksomheder i Danmark og Grønland, og vi betjener dem fra eget lager i Danmark. Vi er en del af en større virksomhedsgruppe, som ledes fra Valencia.
