jobs.title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
jobs.description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. As a Global Security Program Manager on Notion’s Global Safety & Security team, you’ll help protect our people, workplaces, and operations across a distributed global portfolio. This role exists to bring greater consistency to physical security programs as Notion scales—strengthening technology, vendor operations, incident readiness, and local execution without losing the welcoming experience we want employees and guests to feel. You’ll work across Workplace, People, IT, Legal, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design.  - Draft an incident update, using AI to improve clarity, then validate the details and judgment behind the message.

 - Coordinate international project work while responding thoughtfully to an urgent operational issue.

 - By your 90th day, use AI to accelerate clear, effective communications, reduce busywork, and keep detail-heavy work accurate and reviewable.

 - By the end of your first year, deliver multiple international projects with clear plans, sound judgment, and effective coordination across regions, vendors, and cross-functional partners.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

Zakres obowiązków: Asystent rodziny prowadzi pracę z rodziną w miejscu jej zamieszkania lub w miejscu wskazanym przez rodzinę. Zadania asystenta rodziny realizowane są w pełnym wymiarze
czasu pracy w systemie zadaniowym.
Zakres wykonywanych zadań:
1) opracowywanie i realizacja planów pracy z rodzinami, we współpracy z członkami rodziny  i w konsultacji z pracownikiem socjalnym.
2) opracowywanie, we współpracy z członkami rodziny i koordynatorem rodzinnej pieczy
zastępczej, planu pracy z rodziną, który jest skoordynowany z planem pomocy dziecku umieszczonemu w pieczy zastępczej.
3) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w poprawie ich sytuacji życiowej, w tym w zdobywaniu,
umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego
4) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów socjalnych.
Więcej informacji na stronie internetowej:
http://paczkow.naszops.pl/pliki/plik/ogloszenie-asystent-rodziny-1790325922.pdf
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wykształcenie wyższe na kierunku pedagogika, psychologia, socjologia, nauki o rodzinie lub praca socjalna lub wykształcenie wyższe na dowolnym kierunku uzupełnione szkoleniem z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną i udokumentuje co najmniej roczny staż pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną lub średnie branżowe i szkolenie z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną, a także udokumentuje co najmniej 3-letni staż.
Sposób aplikowania:
- bezpośrednio do pracodawcy
- wymagane dokumenty: Druk kwestionariusza osobowego, klauzula informacyjna, oświadczenie dostępne są na stronie
internetowej Ośrodka Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie.
Dokumenty należy składać w sekretariacie Ośrodka do dnia 02.10.2026 r. do godziny 13.00 w
zamkniętej kopercie z dopiskiem: Dotyczy zatrudnienia osoby do wykonywania zadań
asystenta rodziny w Ośrodku Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie lub za pośrednictwem
poczty, kuriera (decyduje data wpływu do Ośrodka). Dokumenty, które wpłyną po upływie
wyżej określonego terminu lub będą niekompletne, nie będą rozpatrywane.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.

jobs.title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Market Head for Central and Northern Europe (m/f)
jobs.description:
Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Lead and manage the Netherland Market composed of Senior Relationship Managers (hunters), as well based out of PBLU.
• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is €200,000 – €350,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude

jobs.title: Global Head of Land Revenue
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll be the global owner for technical new-business strategy, pipeline, and conversion—a customer-facing, technical revenue leadership role, not a RevOps or sales operations role. You’ll own Notion’s Land number (net-new and upgrade iARR across regions), work closely with EPD and Product, and step into high-stakes technical conversations with customers and partners as Notion shifts from product-led to sales-led selling in an AI-native world.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Own the Land-side technical selling motion and set the technical bar for sales: SC plays, discovery and demo standards, scalable demo environments, certification paths, and ramp mechanisms

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Deeply technical SaaS background with meaningful customer-facing experience—solutions engineering, solutions consulting, field or customer engineering, or technical sales—plus ownership of a revenue, quota, pipeline, or conversion outcome

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - Hands-on with AI tools, and able to credibly explain how AI and agents change workflows for technical teams


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptalâs impact on the worldâs largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptalâs partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelorâs degree is required.
  • 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. Weâre not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager DSAR Process Transformation
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager for our client in the media sector.

Role Description:
The client is currently looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and scoping of the automation of our GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) process. The current process is largely manual and involves multiple teams, systems and data owners. The objective of the assignment is to deliver an approved and actionable plan for future automation, including a documented current-state and gap analysis, aligned Privacy requirements, a governance model and a phased roadmap for technical implementation. The aim is to implement technical automation of the GDPR process starting from next year.

The DSAR process has an established process owner who owns the process and related business decisions. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. Team size of 15-20 people.

Responsibilities:
· Lead the planning, coordination and overall delivery of the DSAR automation planning project
· Define and maintain project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines
· Coordinate the mapping and documentation of the current DSAR process across relevant teams, systems and data sources
· Coordinate the identification of process, compliance, governance and technical gaps together with the process owner and subject-matter experts
· Identify and track open questions, risks, dependencies, blockers and required decisions
· Support the process owner and privacy stakeholders in aligning and documenting privacy requirements and required risk decisions
· Coordinate the definition of the future-state process, governance model, roles and responsibilities
· Coordinate technical stakeholders in identifying automation opportunities, integration needs and technical dependencies
· Ensure agreed business, process and privacy requirements are translated into a clear scope for future technical implementation
· Develop a prioritised and phased roadmap for the technical automation build together with technical stakeholders
· Prepare status reporting, recommendations and decision material for management

Expected Deliverables:
· Current-state process map and scope document
· Gap analysis (process, compliance, governance, technical)
· Documented Privacy requirements and risk decisions
· Governance model with defined roles and responsibilities (e.g. RACI)
· Prioritised, phased automation roadmap
· Approved plan with agreed next steps for implementation

Skills and Qualifications:
· Strong experience leading complex cross-functional transformation, regulatory or technology projects
· Strong project management skills
· Previous experience and knowledge of GDPR, privacy programmes, DSAR/DSR processes or other regulatory processes
· Experience with process or workflow automation
· Experience with enterprise data landscapes involving multiple systems and data owners
· Proven ability to structure ambiguous and fragmented problem areas into clear scope, decisions and deliverables
· Experience coordinating work across business and technical stakeholders
· Experience with current-state assessments, gap analyses and roadmap development
· Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills
· Experience managing project risks, dependencies and competing priorities
· Ability to prepare clear management-level recommendations and decision material

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
1. Have you led a GDPR, privacy, or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) transformation project from planning through implementation?
2. Have you managed a cross-functional project involving Legal, Privacy, Data, Technology, and Business stakeholders simultaneously?
3. Have you conducted current-state assessments and gap analyses covering process, governance, compliance, and technology areas?
4. Have you planned or delivered workflow/process automation initiatives involving multiple systems and data owners?
5. Have you created and presented governance models, implementation roadmaps, and decision materials to senior leadership or steering committees?

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE


We’re seeking our first Head of Corporate Development hire to build and own the function, driving acquisition strategy and end-to-end execution to accelerate Replit’s core capabilities. You’ll build and run Replit’s acquisition pipeline, identifying the teams and technologies that can accelerate our mission. You’ll develop a deep understanding of the AI, developer tools, and software infrastructure ecosystem. You’ll build relationships with founders, investors, and industry participants to source and evaluate mergers & acquisitions.

This is a hands-on ownership role for someone who combines strong transaction execution skills with product judgment, relationship-building ability, and the ability to drive complex decisions across teams. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, AI, Engineering, People and Legal. The role reports to the Head of Finance, but partners very closely with our Co-Founder & CEO and President & Head of AI.



What You’ll Do

 - Shape M&A strategy: Partner with senior leadership to define where M&A can accelerate Replit’s product and company strategy, translating strategic priorities into actionable acquisition themes and target areas.

 - Source opportunities: Proactively identify acqui-hire, tuck-in and large-scale acquisition opportunities aligned with Replit’s strategic priorities.

 - Develop relationships: Establish trusted relationships with founders, investors, bankers, operators, and other participants across the ecosystem. Identify and attend industry events to source M&A opportunities.

 - Map the ecosystem: Build and maintain a detailed view of relevant markets, including AI infrastructure, developer tools, emerging technologies, competitors, and potential M&A targets.

 - Evaluate strategic fit: Assess companies and opportunities based on product alignment, market position, technical differentiation, financial profile, and potential value to Replit. Partner with Product, AI, and Engineering leaders to assess build, buy, and partner alternatives and deliver clear go/no-go recommendations.

 - Lead transaction execution: Own the transaction process from initial evaluation through signing and closing. Lead valuation and financial modeling, structure transactions, drive cross-functional due diligence, and lead negotiations in partnership with executive sponsors and Legal. Be accountable for the deal workplan, timelines, risk escalation, and decision materials. Coordinate integration planning with functional leaders, establishing clear owners and success measures before close.



Required Skills and Experience

 - Demonstrated experience leading technology transactions through signing and closing, with direct responsibility for valuation, due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation.

 - Experience researching markets, identifying companies, and developing actionable opportunity pipelines.

 - High degree of ownership, curiosity, and comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - Proven ability to own complex transaction workstreams, hold cross-functional teams accountable to deadlines, and resolve issues across technical, business, and external advisory teams.

jobs.title: Practice Assistant @ White & Case
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled assistant eager to grow your expertise in an international law firm? Do you thrive on helping others in a fast-paced environment? Are you known for your proactive and detail-oriented approach to work?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because this could be the position for you!

**We are looking for** a practice assistant to join White & Case's team in a full-time, permanent position. Key tasks in this role include assisting lawyers with client-related work, along with other tasks to ensure that the daily operations run smoothly at the office. As a practice assistant, you will join a dynamic team of 45 professionals in the Helsinki office.

**In this role,** you will provide assistance across all practice groups. Your responsibilities include a wide range of administrative tasks, such as assisting lawyers with editing and formatting legal documentation, conducting research, providing translation support, as well as preparing and maintaining transaction data rooms. In addition, your duties include liaising with clients, various governmental authorities as well as White & Case's global offices. As a practice assistant, you are also ready to provide support with meeting arrangements, calendar management and other back-office duties.

**You will join** an efficient team of four practice assistants as the fifth member of the team and share your daily work with three evening assistants, a reception assistant and a senior practice assistant. White & Case's team works mainly on-site at their office in the heart of Helsinki, with the flexibility to work remotely once a week during most weeks.

**You may be the person we are looking for if you:**

- have at least one year of experience in a legal assistant or an administrative assistant role within a professional services organization, ideally in a law firm, consulting firm or financial institution;

- have a suitable educational background, such as a Bachelor of Business Administration degree;

- are highly organized and demonstrate great attention to detail;

- enjoy taking initiative and working independently while valuing teamwork and supporting your colleagues;

- are skilled in managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high quality in your work;

- have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and oral communication skills in Finnish and English; and

- are proficient in MS Office programs (especially Word) and able to quickly learn new software and systems.


**White & Case offers you:**

- an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment within a highly regarded international law firm;

- a diverse, key support role where you will also have the opportunity to assist lawyers with client assignments;

- a close-knit work community that invests in the development of each team member; and

- comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare, optional health and accident insurance, and internal training opportunities to support your development. In addition, White & Case offers a selection of alternative benefits, which can be used, for example, for dental care, eyeglasses, a public transport pass, cultural activities or sports.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter **in English** by **Monday 12 October 2026**. We encourage you to apply early, as we will start reviewing applications already during the application period. If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjons recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

_White & Case is a leading global law firm with lawyers and staff in 43 offices across 29 countries, working in virtually every country of the world with a long-established presence in Finland and the Nordic region. White & Case's lawyers and business services professionals are globally minded, enterprising, collaborative and committed to excellence. White & Case operates on a one firm basis, which is present in the day-to-day work of its professionals. They advise multinational corporates, financial institutions and private equity firms on corporate and financing transactions across all major industry sectors. White & Case's core practice areas in Finland are Capital Markets, Debt Finance and M&A/Private Equity._

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

SEINÄJOKI

Seinäjoen Kivistön liikekeskus uudistuu vuoden 2026 aikana, ja avaamme kiinteistöön täysin uuden Ravintolamaailman. Asiakkaita palvelevat jatkossa Hesburger Drive In sekä Rosso Pizza -ravintola.

Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet vuoropäällikkönä sekä Hesburgerissa että Rosso Pizzassa, ja vastaat omalta osaltasi molempien ravintoloiden päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta ja asiakaskokemuksesta. Avoinna oleva työsuhde on vakituinen, osa-aikaisilla työtunneilla 90h/3viikkoa.

Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ravintola-alan tehtäviä, ja pääset osallistumaan laajasti ravintolan toimintaan, prosesseihin sekä arjen sujuvuuden varmistamiseen. Intoa työskennellä vuorotyössä ravintolan aukioloaikoina

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. jobs.title: Baker - Bakery Production - Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at https://newcomers.lolland.dk/. You can also find information about working in Denmark at https://www.workindenmark.dk/

jobs.title: Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
Vire Advisors kasvaa, ja etsimme uutta osaajaa tiimiin. Keskeinen ajatuksemme **Vaikuttava HR ei ole käsityötä** ohjaa tekemistämme. Sinun tehtäväsi on auttaa tekemään siitä ajatus, jonka markkina tuntee, muistaa ja mielellään myös jakaa eteenpäin.

Autamme yrityksiä modernisoimaan johtamista ja HR-tekemistä teknologian, automaatioiden ja tekoälyn avulla. Samalla rakennamme omia teknologiaratkaisujamme, ja SaaS-alustamme **Arviro©** on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että se tarvitsee työbestiksen, jolla on markkinoinnin seniori-osaamista, vauhtia ja joka osaa vahvistaa SaaS tuotteistamisen kaupallista ajattelua.

Etsimme siis kokenutta **Senior Marketing & Growth Specialistia** vahvistamaan brändiämme, kasvattamaan näkyvyyttämme ja rakentamaan markkinointia, joka näkyy myös liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät sisältömarkkinointi, sosiaalinen media, tapahtumat, digitaalinen näkyvyys ja kasvun rakentaminen. Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa rakentaa suunnan mutta ei kavahda käytännön tekemistä.

**Mitä työssäsi teet?**

Vastaat Vire Advisors sisältömarkkinoinnin, sosiaalisen median ja kasvua tukevan markkinoinnin suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- sisältökalenterin ja uusien sisältökonseptien rakentaminen

- LinkedIn- ja Instagram-sisältöjen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- blogien, uutiskirjeiden, asiakastarinoiden ja verkkosisältöjen kirjoittaminen

- asiantuntijoiden ajatusten jalostaminen sisällöiksi, joita muutkin kuin asiantuntijat haluavat lukea

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**

jobs.description:

Facilities Manager Location: Dublin 7, Ireland Salary: €50,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role Sodexo is looking for an experienced Facilities Manager to join our team in Grangegorman. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for the day-to-day management of the on-site hard and soft services team, ensuring excellent service delivery, strong operational performance and compliance with contractual requirements. You’ll play a key role in managing the site team, contractors, maintenance programmes, lifecycle works and reactive client requirements, while driving continuous improvement across the contract. What You’ll Be Doing Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft FM services. Lead, support and develop the on-site service delivery team. Manage planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and lifecycle programmes. Coordinate reactive works and ensure client requirements are delivered effectively. Scope and verify minor works. Manage the SSOW permitting system and promote safe working practices. Lead Toolbox Talks, Safety Walks and Near Miss reporting. Manage contractor engagement and site inductions. Act as the key operational point of contact for on-site issues. Manage materials ordering and maintain accurate contract and project records. Deliver allocated projects on time, within budget and to specification. Monitor remedial works, budgets and expenditure. Support continuous improvement, innovation and cost-reduction initiatives. Build strong relationships with clients, visitors, contractors and internal stakeholders. Prepare reports and monitor operational deadlines and performance. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for an experienced Facilities professional who combines strong people leadership with commercial awareness and excellent customer service. You’ll ideally have: Previous FM management or coordination experience. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience in a client-facing role. Good understanding of FM technical services. Experience working with contracts and commercial requirements. Strong financial and budget management skills. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. The ability to analyse information, make decisions and provide practical solutions. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel. A customer-focused and solutions-oriented approach. The ability to work at pace while maintaining accuracy.

jobs.title: Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.11 2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder på 30-37 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.11.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder på 30-37 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

Der er 10 beboere på en afdeling, og de har en erhvervet hjerneskade. På afdelingen er der ca.15 faste medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte. Hovedgrupperne af ansatte består af SOSU-assistenter, pædagoger og ergo- og fysioterapeuter samt omsorgshjælpere.

Det kan også være du er uddannet SOSU-hjælper eller sygehjælper eller har en masse relevant erfaring fra pleje- og omsorgsområdet, der giver dig gode kompetencer til denne stilling.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der

·        brænder for området og beboere

·        har lyst til at bruge tid sammen med beboerne i løbet af dagen til aktivitet og samvær og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for beboerne

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden. Vi bruger dokumentationssystemet Modulus.

·        Har et smittende humør og en sund og god indstilling til arbejdet og samarbejdet.

 

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Beboernes selvbestemmelse og værdighed ligger os meget på sinde.

Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi arbejder mere og mere med KRAP-modellens anerkendende og ressourceorienterede tilgang, såvel som vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret medarbejder, der har lyst til at indgå i plejen, omsorgen og aktiviteterne for beboerne. Vi arbejder med udvikling af afdelingen såvel monofagligt som tværfagligt, så kompetencer og viden kommer bedst muligt i spil.

Du skal være indstillet på, at der er tale om et arbejde, hvor man skal have en god fysik samt kunne arbejde et sted, hvor man af og til udfordres følelsesmæssigt i sit arbejde.

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig, som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Vi vil glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning og håber, du kan se dig ind i de arbejdsopgaver, der er skitseret ovenfor.

Vil du vide mere er du velkommen til at kontakte forstander Tina Rudebeck Holm på tiruho@aarhus.dk  eller telefonnr. 4185 7871

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomster.

Vi har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus kommune.

Ansøgningsfristen er mandag den 19. oktober kl. 8.00 og ansøgninger kan sendes pr. mail på stefanshjemmet@aarhus.dk mærket ”Medarbejder til HG1”

Der afholdes samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning afsted.

Vi har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus kommune.

jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme raskaan kaluston asentajaa työskentelemään nostolaitteiden pariin Vantaalle! Mikäli sinulla on kokemusta raskaan kaluston huolto- ja asennustöistä sekä vahva ymmärrys hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta, saatat olla juuri etsimämme osaaja.

Tehtävässä työskentelet raskaan kaluston, kuten nostolaitteiden ja työkoneiden parissa, suorittaen huolto- ja asennustöitä sekä kentällä että korjaamolla. Vastaat vaativista huolloista, asennuksista ja vianhauista eri konetyypeille. Työaika on arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7:30-16:00 (40 h/vko). Tässä tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksellemme.

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Kokemusta raskaan kaluston ja erityisesti nostolaitteiden asennuksesta ja huollosta

\- Kykyä etsiä ja hyödyntää teknistä tietoa eri koneista ja järjestelmistä

\- Vahvaa osaamista hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta

\- Valmiuksia vaativiin huolto- ja korjaustöihin

\- Kokemusta vianhausta sekä koneiden testauksesta

\- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- Monipuoliset ja teknisesti mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät

\- Kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen vakaassa yrityksessä

\- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, joka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

jobs.title: Sähkö-/kunnossapitoasentaja, Sähkö-Team Oy (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Sähkö-Team Oy:lle sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon ja korjaukseen keskittyvää asentajaa Helsingin Roihupellossa sijaitsevalle korjaamolle.

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Toimenkuva:

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
